text: This game has actually got worse. The algorithm is vicious, you can easily run through 10 tiles waiting for a match, which means you inevitably lose because the cost of extra tiles is obscenely high and rewards are really low. This happens over and over again. As many rewards are based on maintaining a streak, you'll never get them. A shame because the game is otherwise fun to play, and I'd be more inclined to spend money on it if they weren't so blatant in their attempts to fleece you.

I kinda liked the game at first, although as I got up a few levels I quickly realized that you need to pay real. money if you want to continue playing. it costs in game coins to do anything and they run out fast, leaving you with no option but to end the game unless you want to pay real money. it's also just a complete game of chance, no strategy involved.

Fun if you go into it with the right expectations. The game presents itself as a puzzle game where logic wins but it works as something similar to a slot machine. There is no logical progression to complete the "puzzle" instead you are often presented with a series of 50/50 choices, making the incorrect choice means you lose. You spend coins to play and winning means you get those coins back and a few more, but not making the right guesses means you lose all your coins.

the algorithm is programmed so you always run out of coins and pumps you with offers for deals with real cash. you'll notice when it is doing it because you will constantly lose games because you were never given enough correct domino's to complete the level. it will do this continuously until you run out of coins. I have tested this across multiple devices on multiple accounts with different WiFi networks and the algorithm does the same thing for everyone. its really bad when you think about it

Started out fun, but keeps popping out offers for in-game purchase with every single thing you do, it's frankly very annoying. The game made it impossible to achieve things like keeping your pet without spending a lot of money, the milestones jump between the final level to keep pet and the one before is very unreasonable, same with other 'events' which reset very quickly, making them impossible to complete without paying an exorbitant amount of money.

Used to good to pass the time but now its getting to be pricey. This time 2 weeks ago I was using 29000 coins to play a game, then it went up, without progressing a level/zone to 92000, now, again without progressing a zone/level, its 138000!! it's ridiculous! Yes you do get enough coins every hour to play a game but the wins from trial and side games rarely give enough, especially now. Unless I want to pay a lot of money then it's just not worth it anymore.

Do not play under any circumstances. The game is biblically rigged. It is set up that the more coins you have the less chance you have of getting the dominos you need. I have lost count of the amount of times I would have 5-10 tiles left and it would magically miss any I needed to make me spend coins. It makes the initial levels easy to get you to play and then as your progress you have to spend coins on 80% of the levels. The events have loads of bugs and don't register properly. Rigged.

Like every mobile game, it's all about your money, you get enough coins each hour, to play roughly 1 or 2 games, depending how the tiles stack, it's impossible to finish some levels without spending coins, so basically it's rigged for you to put money on, just to play dominoes, now if that's your thing, yeah, go ahead, and if you enjoy 50 pop ups everytime you finish a level this game is perfect for you, otherwise I don't recommend it.

Evident soft blocking by the game. At a certain point you are forced into relying on the hourly bonuses to play, at which point it will continue to give you scenarios where you are one domino away from finishing the level, encouraging you to pay for in-game currency to finish it. Events are only completable through micro transactions due to the short window they are active for before a reset. 9/10 times you will not succeed the level without purchasing more dominos or the golden domino.

Been on this game for 7 wks, What a waste of time & £ .You WILL have to spend real cash in this game, too much going on constantly pushing the packages available for money this interferes with game play. I have bought different bundles each time there is problem with what you order to what they send, the rewards don't add up, giving you less than what was offered in the bundle.Be on the LOOKOUT and CHECK your rewards they are ROBBING you. .I have took s/s of errors, but cant upload to C/S 😡😡

I paid 6.99 for an offer they had going and I never received the whole offer. I emailed support in regards to this and heard nothing back! I haven't played since as it annoyed me to be honest which is a shame as I loved this game! 😒 update..04/26 now had a total of 8 failed purchases! they either don't give you the reward or you get half of what you've paid for! many emails sent to support to no reply!! Great game! AVOID IN APP PURCHASING!!!

So so frustrating as could be a great game but majority of time your on last tile and wants you to spend money. Played today and spent money but even 800000 lasted less than 5 mins. Every time I played always run out of tiles so cost you. It should be much fairer otherwise it could be a great game. Got to the point of playing one game then wait till next day. It would have got more stars in review if it was more fair.

long time player of this game but currently it costs me 12,500 to play a level but when I win I'm getting 12,294 back? This is a loss despite winning the level meaning I dont make enough to play the next one. Hoped this was just a one off or an in app issue so tried again over the course of a few days but the same thing keeps happening! Feels like a ploy now to HAVE to make in app purchases. I have contacted support to see what they say but currently I am not impressed.

Very obviously rigged to prevent success without major money input. The first 50 levels or something are great but beyond that many of card deals are impossible so you have to redo repeatedly and run out of coins. Have tested a couple and proved this to be true - no matter what order you turn the cards, with the combination of cards on the board it is IMPOSSIBLE to win.

I'm not sure how this game has such high reviews. It's pay to play and win. I'm only on chapter 4 and the pay wall is increasing constantly. Now it's nine tasks for a chapter, with each needing 4 or more stars (levels). You have to pay 2K coins to even start a level. Bad RNG means you can get 20 dominoes in a row that don't match what you want and, you guessed it, another 3-4K coins for three extra cards. Everything is designed to slow and hinder you so that you pay to progress.

basically gambling, paying your coins to do a "luck" based level against an algorithm that seems designed to get you to the last couple of tiles and you must spend more coins to finish the level or repeat, regardless of how logical your moves through the level are. Don't be fooled by the first half an hour where it gets you into the game, it will shift, and you will have one tile lift and draw 3 in a row that don't have a single match, all to make you to spend money. could be fun with tweaks.

Wierrdly addictive and game runs very much like Disney Solitaire (I know its dominos but if you play both you would see what I mean. Like the ability to go back a move (for a limited number of "tries" that the player stacks up to use in the future), and the advancent through the stages by collecting stars to "buy" the different elements that make up the stage/scene/level. I assume the dev team is the same or i would even argue would be a legit legal suit situation. Anyway its a clever technique.

Don't waste your time, or money. Seems fun at first, but as you progress, the cost to play in "coins" increases significantly, but the rewards for winning, which seems suspiciously difficult, are incredibly low. You can buy helps, but these become ridiculously expensive. I did actually buy some game coins, but these did not last long, due to the huge imbalance between cost to play and rewards for winning the hand. They push the in-app purchases a LOT. Awful. I'd give -5 if I could.

Lovely graphics. Otherwise, the game is not worth any player's time. Makes you spend your in-game coins to win levels. Played to level 32. Uninstalling after losing 16,000 coin to find the one piece in extra tiles to match the last tile in the game. Not worth the hassle. Not everyone can refresh their coin balance by tapping the free top up every hour. And most people won't be able to afford to buy the extra coin with real money.

Listen, It's a very cute game, but playing it, I kept being reminded of the housing market? The number of coins you need keeps going up, but the number of coins you're earning stays the same, and you're eventually crushed by the difference. The realism hit a little too close to home there, well done. This game has no ads, so I suppose that's their chosen... "gotcha", so to speak? To encourage you to spend real money buying game coins. That's fine

The game itself is fun, though designed to be addictive as you have to keep checking back regularly to get coins. I'm rating it down because to actually progress in the game, you need to pay a lot (which I refuse to do for any game) or you sit having to watch long ads. And I've probably watched more ads longer than I've played the game now. And the rewards you get are too small for the amount if time I've wasted running ads (I don't even look at what they are for). So losing interest quickly.

really nice app and fun to play. lots of cute stuff. pop ups are insanely annoying, yeah it's ad free but they are in the way. not to mention, being that it's a solitaire like game there are sometimes levels which are just straight up unsolvable, which is fine but once you run out of coins if you're not willing to pay there's nothing you can do to get more so you straight up can't play anymore. plus the money goes so fast with how ridiculously everything prices up. can't even play hourly 🫠

I really like the concept of the game, the cute characters and bright colours. However, it is definitely rigged to try and get you to spend money as sometimes you consistently get given a bad hand of dominos to play and then can't play again for another hour until you get more coins. Also, the amount of pop ups it has is extremely annoying. It's a shame as I'd love the game if I could actually play it properly.

the game does not at all reward you with enough coins for the amount needed to spend on each level. It seems money hungry, and from what I can conclude, they just want you to spend money to get coins. strategy almost never helps, as it seems to be that almost every level requires you to spend money on a boost like 3 cards or a wildcard to get a win.. I have looked at other reviews, and they bring up the same problem, and the developers say "we'll look into it." you can start now, dear devolpers

I'm not sure this game actually wants to be played, each game costs gold to even play, you win so little if you get a clean round and if you don't, all your gold gets swallowed trying to finish it. It's also pretty obnoxious with pop ups, be they events or its cash shop. I'd never played dominos before but after a few games I can't keep playing to get better without spending real money to the point of irritation.

Would have been a 4/5 star, if not for the fact that the the ad track disappeared over a month ago and will not come back no matter what I do. Tried updating, reinstalling, toggling wifi on and off, nothing will work. How am I supposed to beat hard levels if there's no way to earn extra coins? Why can't you just have rechargeable lives like other games? Will be uninstalling soon as it's no fun when you can only gather enough coins to play one level per day!

it's pretty fun. I'm adding an amendment now that I'm further into the game. It is too difficult to win coins. the challenges mostly require you to win streaks, but it costs so many coins to get additional dominos to finish the round and keep your streak, and the prizes for winning the events often don't have enough coins to build back your coin stash. You can get more coins every hour, but you have to log in to get them, which is really frustrating.

I like the concept of the game and the game itself is good however each game charges over 2000 points to play, then if you need more dominos it charges a ridiculous amounts of points. You get an allowence of 2000 points every hour but its used up quickly, making progression slow unless you spend lots of money to buy more points! It is very focused on you spending money, like most games but most games give some sort of game to play this doesn't really.

The gameplay would be enjoyable, if it wasn't for the blatant push to get your money. One of the worst games I've played. Even if you cave in and buy coins, they'll run out quickly due to the RNG of the domino deck. The only reason to purchase things in this game is because you're trying to complete a task for a certain other app. That's it. If you came across this game by chance or you picked it up for a task, I implore you to leave. It's not worth it.

The game itself is fine, but it is very pay to win. Some games you can get a nice clear run clearing the board with good use of Dominos, then you'll find a level where you literally have to just use so many coins to get though it as the only way to finish is using so many power ups that cost more and more money as you go. any tournament means you better get ready to pay or you aren't going to do a thing in it without opening that wallet. Coin rewards tend to be way too low also.

I like the game itself, but the fact that each turn cost you coins is silly. One round cost you let's say 3,000 coins but when you pass you only get about 3,200 back so it's impossible to play without buying in game stuff which is ridiculous I am on the hunt for the game that's similar but doesn't require in game purchases to actually play. You only get one turn worth of coins once an hour, no possible to get coins other than buying

This game is like a bottomless pit. I've lost count of how much I've spent on it, with nothing to show for it at all. It's unbelievably greedy. I intend to delete it, as I only downloaded it in the hope of getting paid to play it, via the Freecash app, which is also something of a con. It's ridiculous and very unfair, as basically unless you keep purchasing coins, almost on a daily basis, it's impossible to progress. It just isn't worth the money and effort.

For 2 days straight I've been stuck in a loop of pop ups in game. When I try to start a round, all of the pop ups for purchase start and I can never start a new game. It goes through all 5 or 6 of them, goes back to the start new game screen, and then all the pop ups come back again. I am able to play w couple rounds when I first open the app, but then this happens again

Advert heavy. on first opening at least 8-10 pop up notifications, then as you play several more appearances. I get you want to make money, but I just want to the play the game. with so many adverts, I really can't be bothered. worse is that all the close X's appear in dofferent parts of the screen. Just annoying.

The levels are colourful, the domino mechanics are simple but still strategic. It felt relaxing and satisfying, especially in the early stages when progression moved at a nice pace. As I got further in, the coin system can be pretty unforgiving unless you are prepared to pay to play.Overall, I still think is fun and has a lot of charm, but it can feel grindy and a bit pushy with monetization the further you go. It’s enjoyable as a casual time-killer just be prepared for some slow progress

I'm absolutely addicted to this game! It resembles several solitare games that I've played, except with dominoes, obviously. They definitely want you to buy things in the game, however, you don't have to (most likely because there are no commercials...Thank Goodness! I think that anyone reading this review is completely sick of commercials in OTHER games. I highly recommend.

"Support" is no help. The ads that pop up no matter how many times you've seen them and can't get to stop are likely the cause for the game to just stop working and kick me out over and over. The newest update hasn't changed anything and no other game on my phone does this, so I'm done. Uninstalling and reinstalling after each level worked for two days. The newest update made it so even that doesn't work.

it's ok, but it will make you lose if it wants you to. there is not a guarantee to ever have a level be possible to solve without buying more dominos that cost 6x more in game coins than you earn from completing a level, and sometimes you'll need more than one set of extras. it's very frustrating.

hate this game. you don't get enough coins as rewards to keep playing levels unless you buy them. playing is mostly luck not skill. you can play perfectly and then not get a match for the last tile for 10 turns or more making you have to spend more money to keep playing. not fun at all and i can't wait to get rid of this thing. I got up to scene 7 and am now uninstalling immediately.

Reached level 75 and not able to pass even one level in one day. They make it super hard to pair consecutively and super slow to earn coins. Most of the time can only pair once and then need to spend coins for additional chances which can pair up NOTHING. This game is being too greedy and only brings annoyance. Uninstalled.

this game can be very addictive but when you start winning money & get up to 2 or $300,000 then you just keep losing your money after that. The game is set up like this because it happens everytime I start winning. You also have to be careful because in the middle of the game if you accidentally hit one of the boosters it automatically charges you & you're out of $178,000. I'm deleting everything is expensive then you have to spend the whole day getting your money up just to be able play 1 game

the game is okay, this game is really based on luck, but it doesn't feel that way. Feel like the game developers made it so that you are forced to spend coins on more cards, WHICH is the only way to play levels on this game. Maybe they should add energy as a way to play levels so that coins can just be used on extra cards and stuff, instead of being used on everything in the game

Dominos with heavy cute animation. nothing is quick, as you progress, the levels are actually impossible without buy ins, which they heavily advertise and hope you will purchase. I wouldnt bother unless I was paid to play, which it's very little, it's just not that fun even without the cheating and ads.

This is a fun domino game, especially if you just want to play a couple levels a day. Initially progress is quick and fun, however around chapter 7, there is a significant slow down. Passing levels without using a power up becomes infrequent, and the price increase to purchase power ups greatly outweighs the amount you earn for completing levels. Also annoying that I have to exit out of 5-10 pop ups everytime I open the app, but that is a minor annoyance.

this game is more geared towards making you spend $ than any others, so I haven't gotten very far in a couple months. also means if you're using a pay-to-play site, you'll not hit most of the goals before they expire. you only get 1 star per level, no matter how well you do, so it takes forever to complete a chapter. there are no helps to get you past a tough level, & after a number of successful levels in a row, the algorithm inevitably gives you a level that takes most of your coins to pass.

The game is really fun... Until it isn't. I see a lot of other reviewers that say it can be done completely free, but that's with a lot of waiting, or a lot of luck. I've had to top up several times already and I'm only on level 129. The fact that helps increase in in-game currency cost as you progress (or depending on how often you use them, unsure) does not help. Unless you have some expendable income or really believe in your own luck, I wouldn't expect much.

It would be fun, but it takes a ridiculous amount of coins to play each round, (about 2000, just about as much as you can win per a round) when you lose a round it demands the same amount to try again, this is a real vibe wrecker. I don't play as much as I would like to because the game mechanics straight up prevent me. I have found that games that give you more tries every few minutes are way more fun. It is a cash grab full of ads, and makes you lose frequently to tempt you into spending.

Forced pay to play game. Initially fun, but after a while it will make you lose repeatedly until you decide to pay up. There's about 8 simultaneous events going on, each wanting you to pay. No matter how many dominos left in your stack, eventually it will make you lose every time. Takes all fun out of it. Replying to developer: The app isn't too difficult. That's not what I said. I'm saying the app is intentionally designed to force people to pay to continue playing as you progress.

I actually enjoy this game, as I enjoy solving puzzles, but each new level requires too many coins. It also shouldn't be more than twice as many coins to use the golden card if there's one left at the end. Makes it a lot less fun. It's also not just the 1 hour wait for bonuses. It's that all you get when you win is the coins back that you spent to play that round so there's no way to get ahead with them either. Having no ads is only a benefit if players can actually play the game.

It was really fun at first and then it goes to a snail's pace for progress unless you spend cash at every corner. Also, EVERY time you open the app, you have to click through about 9 popups trying to sell you boosters or telling you about some 'event' that you've already clicked through multiple times before. The events don't last nearly long enough. They're specifically designed to be unattainable unless you spend money. Great for the company, terrible for the gamers. Pay to play, NOT free...

Its fine except for all the pop ups and making me go through the "trials" or "rules" every time an event restarts. I've been playing for years, I KNOW how the fairy trail works, I KNOW how the dream pass work, I KNOW how it all works and forcing users to go through the tutorial every time instead of having the option to say I've played it before and skip it is annoying. And when you give 10 minutes of free play, most of it is taken up by pop up so there's no point in actually giving them out.

The mechanics in this game are not balanced. Sometimes a round starts with no available moves to make. It doesn't matter how perfectly you strategize your moves; the game is just based on luck. I got to around level 70, and the game just kept not giving dominos that matched. And, every time I replayed the level, it was different. You win if you're lucky. There's no way to get good at this game. It keeps you playing by not giving matching dominoes so you just have to repeat a level for eternity.

The game itself is good. What I hate about this game is you have to have coins to play. If you cant pass the level you can buy more dominoes to keep playing. The problem is that costs A LOT of coins. In the end they give you just enough to play about 1 game per hour. If you don't pass that level, then you will have to play it again and probably need about 3 log ins or more just to do so. Now you are asking me to log in 3 or 4 times just to play 1 level. No! Sorry. Serious flaw.

This game is good but very frustrating. You do get a lot of bells and whistles when you win a level, and not having tons of random ads is great. My issue is, for a game based on chance, the gold cost to continue is crazy. Each level costs 2,200 gold (for where I currently am) to play, and you keep pressing new tiles and get through half your stack before making 1 match. When that stack runs out you can pay 3,800 gold for 3 tiles that may not even make a match. Then cost goes up from there.

Quit before you lose a fortune! This game starts out so fun, but gets ridiculously impossible very quickly. In order to play more than 1 round per hour, you have to buy coins once you get to the higher stages. Sometimes, you even lose coins on a level, even if you win the level, which is absolutely ridiculous! The cost of playing a round goes up really quickly, while the payouts do not. This game is great in the beginning, but don't fall in love with it. It will break your heart and your bank!

This game is pay to play. It takes gold to attempt levels, and the tiles you get are random, meaning that levels are frequently unsolvable. This is not a puzzle game; it's closer to playing slots. You get gold from solving levels, or from the store. You inevitably use more gold than you make, even if you play perfectly with no mistakes.

like solitaire but with dominos. be prepared to lose a lot, it's 25% strategy, 75% luck; it always comes down to the unturned tiles. must spend coins to play the next game, and it gets progressively more expensive. between games, you are forced to wait through the very long animations, which waste massive amounts of time. boring.

The unfortunate reality is the company behind the game needs to make money. Since they've opted to avoid making money with ads, you'll have to pay just to play after a while. The volume of single-option win paths gets bigger and bigger as you get past about level 80. Eventually the extra tile and wild tile purchases get so expensive that you're forced to either wait for the coin bank to replenish or pay for coins. EDIT: dropped to 1 star because it got even worse.

I love this game but I'm about to delete it because I'm tired of the game being rigged to purposely hold out needed pieces to force you to buy more coins. I've already spent enough on this app. Update: still not any better. Can only play one round because each round cost WAY too many coins then purposely makes it hard to progress without spending money. Ridiculous. I'd rather have the option to watch an ad to earn more coins so I think I'm gonna delete.

Gets unfair to players as you move up in levels. A gold wild card domino is like 400 coins on chapter 1. By chapter 3, it's 4000 coins! Developers are making a cash grab for no reason. It totally takes the fun out of this game for me. It stalls out game play & makes progression slow & painful. Totally lost interest after that. Who cares how many chapters there are if you can't get there! Coin value for extra cards & gold tiles should be the same for each level. Negative stars :-(

Okay, so I've been playing this game for a long while. I'm on levels in the 1400s... I've spent money. More than I care to count for a mobile game.... and yet it's still IMPOSSIBLE to get all the recipes... I literally need 2 bottles of ketchup and it seems like the only way to do that is by buying the wins... the odds on this game feel more skewed in favor of the dealer the more I play. $100 spent in the last two weeks and I am still fighting the current trying to complete mini game challenges

This game would have great potential if they didn't make it impossible to win. They need to reward you with more coins more often. I've only tried to play it so much cause I get rewarded from another app for playing it. But it's garbage. You can't pass a level without spending all your coins and then you get nothing out of it. It's a garbage game and doesn't reward you enough. If you want to spend useless money on it then you might have fun playing it.

It starts off lots of fun, but then it becomes not really free if you want to advance. I agree with the other reviews that the cost of rounds is too high, and they quickly become too difficult to pass in one or two attempts. I'd rather it give us the option to watch an ad or two for a retry. I'll probably be uninstalling soon.

Don't waste your time with this game. It's boring and it's designed to make sure you can't get far without spending any money on it. FULL of pop ups for things you can pay to add on for an "advantage" but what it actually means is if you don't pay, you can't really play. Anyone claiming otherwise is being paid to say so or they're bots. You'll find this game on sites that say you'll win real prizes. The only way to "win" is to spend more money on this game than what the winnings will provide.

Having to close out no less than 6 attempts to get you to spend real money before you can play every single time you open the app is annoying. Game is fun but the win to loss ratio is way off to get you to spend money to keep playing. Waiting an hour to hope the levels beatable this time sucks. Deleted the game today. Unbeatable levels in hopes i spend money to beat a level or 2 before hitting another unmakes it completely unenjoyable. The games fun but not good enough to pay to play

Yeah no, don't download this. This game goes far out of it's way to make it impossible to play unless you're willing to spend stupid amounts of money. Essentially throw your whole life away amounts of money. Btw any ads they make you watch to get the supposed "free w/t ads" rewards is a lie. 2 Ads in and they're already charging $0.99 which adds up quick. This game is entirely useless so don't even bother lol.

The game is fun, but man when I load it up I have to tap through literally ELEVEN pop ups. I appreciate that you're trying to have events, but omg just let me play the game. Not every single thing needs to pop up. Just put an icon with a notification symbol for most of them. Or have it pop up ONCE and then just be a icon next time I open the app. It's actually insane how many pop ups there are on launch.

I grew up playing dominoes with my grandparents for many years as a young child and this is a really nice twist on the original version of Dominoes. I like the color scheme that they use on the tiles and the characters are really cute, and funny. The tile layout also gets more and more challenging as you progress through the levels. So I'm really looking forward to playing this fun game every day!

I really like this game! My advice would be to really think each play through. My mistake in the beginning was that I used up all my coins quickly, and then I had none later in the game. The further you progress in the game, the more it costs if you lose on a level. Instead of using up all your coins to win 1 level, it is much smarter to end the game and keep your remaining coins. Then drop the multiplier on the next try so you won't go through all your coins to finish one level.

This app has a million pop-ups. there were 19 when I opened the app this morning. NINETEEN! You can close out of each without purchasing anything, but it adds time to when you can collect rewards. There are also now pop-ups between levels. You can't always just go to the next level without closing a bunch of ads for in-game purchases. everything was for the game, but it's still frustrating.

Best game to play, easy to play, and easy to understand. I'm having a blast at the beginning of this game. Cannot wait to get harder levels... Edit: The game becomes unplayable around LEVELS 30-40 and so on. It's a 5 stars in the beginning, but the moment you get to the higher levels, it's a waste of time. Dominos do not match sometimes its 6-7 nothing, money coins run out, and annoying 10 pop-ups that waste my time every day.

Pay attention when moving through the puzzle games and make sure that you get ALL of the items you are supposed to get. I have been ripped off MANY times during the temple puzzle game by not receiving all items in chests. If you don't watch you don't even realize it. Makes it easy to keep you from "winning" or getting too far along in the game. If you win more than two games in a row give it a break because almost guaranteed after that you will lose until you have to spend $$ to keep playing.

Unplayable without significant cash after level 7. I actually don't mind spending a few dollars here and there on a game but this is easily the most predatory game I have seen in a long time. You have to pay to play each round. if you win, you barely get enough reward to cover the entry fee. Moreover, it gets dramatically more expensive with every level AND the amount of work to advance through chapters.

I really enjoyed playing the game but I have to agree with the other reviews mentioning about the coins/cost to play next levels. Mine is currently at 13,000 coins to go to next levels, which is crazy high considering that the daily checkin rewards are only 20-50k coins. Not to mention that every time I open the app, I get bombarded with the sales ads nonstop. It's a fun game, but has BIG room for improvement, please.

Do not waste your time on this app unless you want to be forced to pay to play. What do I mean? Simply that it's a puzzle game that will actually avoid giving you solutions to drain your coins so you have to buy more. You might get one to three rounds finished without having to pay out because the dominoes in reserve literally dodge giving you the last one you need. If you're lucky, otherwise you're stuck paying out triple to quadruple the amount of coins you paid to get into the match. Avoid it

Simple game to get you addicted in hopes of getting you to spend money. That's fine, but there are some pretty deceptive practices. For example, if you tap on a promo, it asks how you want to pay and if you press 'x', it will take you to the checkout instead of exiting out. Way more examples that won't fit in this review.

This is pure frustration. I downloaded your game, played it, and reached a high level just for the 50 Play Points quest. Then, you force me to invite a friend? Not only are the incentives poor in exchange for real currency, but you can easily chew through your coins in a single game since matching tiles are purely luck based. Very little skill is needed unfortunately.

The game is fun to play, but several things lacking. The cost per round is woefully unbalanced with the rewards. Especially if you have to use any "power ups". If you make purchases, the app will likely crash, leaving you without the items and without your money. Support was really good the first couple times I had issues, but after that, I haven't been able to get any help. Seriously reconsider spending any money on this game. Oh, and the in game "event" ads are ridiculously frequent.

I liked this game better than other games made by this dev. There's way too many in-game pop up ads. In the two minutes of ads that must be clicked out of before u can claim rewards/play, I lose interest. So by the time I can play, I no longer really want to. Also half the puzzles are awfully designed. More often than not, the 1st 3 tiles have to come from the draw pile. It's lame not to start w/ a match. You should be able to start puzzle before having to draw.

Update: Finally deleted off my phone!! What a relief. Fun, addictive game. Great animations. At a certain point, it becomes too expensive. You can buy $5 worth of coins and burn through them in quite literally less than a minute because the dominoes that turn over don't match what you need. They give you enough coins to play one game per hour for free, but that limits you to about 2-3 minutes of gameplay per hour. The help tools, once you advance far enough, are just too expensive.

MICRO TRANSACTION HAVEN. Everything in the game forces you to pay to play. They lure you in with generous giftings in the beginning, but after you hit level 75, everything changes. You can play a perfect game and have 6 tiles spare and one tile left and none of them match. Even if you do the option to add more tiles, there is no guarantee you'll complete the level. The events are so quick that it's impossible to complete without your wallet! good luck!

don't know if it's just me, but the sound effect volume is like 3 times as loud as the music is. it hurts my ears. I have to play on super low volume and can't hear the music! a volume slider for each sound channel would be an amazing update. otherwise, it's a fun game, annoying as hell with all the pop-ups every time you boot up though. like...a comical amount of things they want you to buy.

You should change the name of the game to "Pop-Up Dreams"!!! I have never seen so many !! It was fun for a while... then it became abundantly clear that this is all about money. you can open the app without 5+ popups trying to sell you different items. If you think you can play the game without buying anything, you are wrong. The only exception is the game gives you coins once an hour for free. Basically, you need to claim the free coins three times (3 hours) in order to pass a single level.

This game started out great, I enjoyed the gameplay and it was challenging enough to be fun without being frustrating. Then it just gets progressively worse. The levels become impossible to complete without paying for boosts, which means you are constantly running out of coins, which it then pushes you (repeatedly and in a dozen ways) to pay actual money to keep playing. I get that it's ad free, but I hate that it's becoming unplayable without paying.

I rarely give bad reviews but I had to give my two cents. This game is fun to play,for a while. But when you reach higher levels,say after lvl 200 it's almost impossible to progress.you have to pay coins to start a level,but then again you only get coins every hour or when you beat a level ,so if you re stuck you have to wait anothe r hour to try again and lose again. Its like they want you to pay money to play.such a money grab. I'd honestly rather watch ads and be able to play. Disappointed

I'll start by saying, this game is very very fun and a great time killer. the graphics and interface are great and easy to use. It is a very well designed product. I test games on the side through third party apps so I'm pretty familiar with the way mobile games operate. I do think the developers need to give more coins or lessen the coin cost each level. it will help with player retention. it gets insanely difficult without spending once you reach a certain level. The game would be 5 stars :)

Very fun! Very addictive! BUT... beware the cost to play later on. When I started I was able to get into the rhythm of carefully planning out every move and plan ahead making sure I had enough gold to start another level. And I was able to earn it through the challenges BUT... as you get through levels the cost to start a new one gets higher and higher while the rewards from the challenges does not. Unless I pay for more gold now I have to wait an hour at a time and it's almost unplayable.

Cute and colorful game. I really enjoyed it at first, but the higher I get the more frustrated I get with the algorithm. I should not have to play a level more than 5 times to win it. I am not going to spend a bunch of money to pass levels, considering deleting. Collectors Trail is set so that you rarely land on a prize space. Twice I have made $2.99 purchases on a prize trail and got all items but the tile not be removed to allow progress. I sent an email with all proof but no response.

This game has a lot of potential, but they ruin it with their obvious attempts to coerce you into spending money! The amount of times they'll waste at least half your draw pile while trying to match ONE domino is ridiculous, as is the number of levels you need to win in order to move onto the next chapter! (All the rewards get multiplied based on the difficulty mode you select, except for the chapter stars.) Also, they CONSTANTLY bombard you with the same 5+ pop-ups, which is really annoying! 😑

Was fun, but now? Meh. The farther along you get into the game, it is almost impossible to move to the next level and chapter. A plus is that there are no ads. The downside is that you would probably have to pay in order to make it to new levels. Uninstalling now. The last tiles almost never match, and trying to get wild cards requires way too many coins, leaving you out of coins when proceeding with the game. Not fun anymore. Cute art, though.

It's a cute game but its almost impossible to move through the levels/chapters. It's set up to fail as I kept getting the same dominos back to back. You pay coins per level to play and when you win, sometimes you don't win enough coins to cover the level you just played and the further you go into the chapter(s) the more it cost to play each level. Don't get me started on the stars "awarded" when you win a level. You need between 2-7 from what I've seen to finish activity within each chapter.

I downloaded this game through Fast Cash. I played several days and then stopped getting credit for anything after 2 days. Example, you get a few cents for every day you play, more for levels. I played for around 2 weeks, got credit for 2 days and 2 levels instead of 4. I started to open a ticket, but too many hoops to jump through. Didn't enjoy it that much, so just deleted it and forgot about the $5 or so I had accumulated.

This could be a great game IF it didn't try so hard to run me out of coins (coins are needed to play levels). If I play on the lowest level that gives miniscule rewards, I win most of the time...but if I up my bet? Forget about it! It's programed to make you loose unless you spend your precious coins in an amount you can't come close to winning back. I refuse to spend real money on coins to play levels! Other than that...it's a great game!

I LOVE this game. However, the last day in a half it has started crashing and closing out after about 2-3 minutes of gameplay. Also, I emailed support about 2 weeks ago because I purchased some in-game credit and it froze and crashed before I got the credit..... Never heard back, never got a refund, and never got the game credit. It is what it is. But I'm really irritated that it's crashing now, I can't even complete a level and it will crash in the middle of it. Super frustrating 😔

When I 1st started playing the game I really enjoyed it. However, the enjoyment has dropped off. You pay x amount of coins to play a round but then you barely earn any coins above what you paid when you win. You can never finish the little games they have unless you play 5-6 hrs a day. You're constantly bombarded with being asked to buy their overly priced packages in order to play. Now, my game is frozen on the "play" screen.

Very fun, I enjoy the challenges, and the play. Best of all, no ads! My only complaint is that you basically get one life per hour for free. basically it gives you 1 Play worth of coin, then you have to log in and collect before it starts building more. So if you lose a level, you either have to pay, or wait an hour if you haven't built up enough coin.. I think it should be enough for five games, and then it pauses till you collect, or something similar. I'd even watch an ad for lives/coin.

The game is SUPER addicting. However, once you get past the first 50 levels, the game becomes very pay-2-play. You'll encounter times where no matter what you do, or could've done, beating the level would be impossible without purchasing an extra domino. If there was a watch-an-ad to play a level to substitute the increasing price to play a level maybe it'd be a 4-star.

I really like this game except for 2 things. The guaranteed fail setup in levels. It's not fun to play games when there is zero chance of winning and moving on. 2) the amount of ads or sales gimmicks you have to click through just to play the game each time. Great game but could improve to be less obvious of only focused on demanding money to play.

It's a fun game, in the beginning. After a while, not so much. Trying 6-7 times a level to manage to pass it, without help. The amount of coins you get from each level is extremely little, barely enough to go to the next stage , but if you need a help (gold tile or 3 more tiles at the end of the stage) , game over, as those, increase by a lot and the payment stays almost the same. So, in conclusion, you need to pay if you want to keep playing.

MONEY GRABBER. I'm playing this to get points on a different app. it's not bad, but I do find it frustrating how many points it costs to play levels vs. the win pay out. Perhaps it's just a new concept for me. Some levels are irritating as I'm normally pretty decent in regard to matching games. I guess it's a challenge. more power up/booster/helps during the levels would be nice as they're too expensive to use regularly. I assume that's incentive to spend actual money. disliking game as I go on.

For some reason my energy on the trails seem to randomly disappear. It happens a lot but for an example, just now I went into the trail, 13 energy. I have the bet amount set to 2. So for every spin I lose 2 energy. I spun 1 time, look down at my energy and instead of 11, I have 5. Bet amount still set to 2. What is going on? I know this game sets you up for failure but that's just shady.

I really do enjoy this game! However, the ability to advance is frustrating. As you go through levels, the cost of coins to play a level slowly goes up and the rewards don't always match. A level costs 6k to play, but you go through 10 levels to get a reward of 500 coins. Some levels seem impossible to beat and the minis don't last long enough to complete 100% unless you spend actual money. I would like the game a lot more if there was a way to get something in return without spending money.

it's a great game but for only for a short time. high cost to play levels and you dont get rewarded much, you break even when you win. The events are short, really would like them to last longer. I wished their was ads to get more domino's instead of paying in coins. I tried at least 4 times for a winning streak to claim the ultimate prize and then the last game I don't get good moves and I have to start all over again. I probably won't keep this app installed, needs improvements.

The game and the animation is awesome. But the amount of coins it takes to get extra cards, for example, is a ridiculous amount in my opinion. I find myself constantly having to wait to play again...waiting for some small amount of coins, so that i can play again. One game can eat up all of my coins. Doing the free version of this game is too difficult. Not sure how much longer I'll stay on it.

My game also started crashing as of 9/22/2024. It attempts to open but then closes. I like the game but you can only play for a few minutes. Then coins run out. Even when I do purchase more, they only last a short while. It makes the game frustrating & disappointing. I've been very close to Uninstalling it, then I receive a bonus. I think the game is fun but is to purchase oriented.

Game was fun for awhile, but after a certain level there's no winning, at least on my part. Ya run outta coins, gotta wait for the coin freebie only to lose it all again. No way in hell I'm spending to load up. Only did it for a third party app for cash achievements. Overall a solid 4.5, but not for me. I'd recommend if ya have time to waste—picking where your next move will lead, it's fun. Not my beat though.

Couple of months ago the game started closing all on its own. Mostly when I was about to collect a prize or in the middle of one of the challenges. When I would reopen, it would all be lost or it was back to long before claiming prize. (I'd have to start whatever task all over and hopefully would have the same results... winning. So far has been 50/50.) I don't care to lose items I've purchased or earned. Not spending another dime and if it closes, I'll just move on to a different game.

Overall, Domino Dreams is super fun and also frustrating at the same time! Domino Dreams is the first game I've spent money on. I do notice that I win more when I do! One thing that frustrates me, is when the round lets you play all the way to the last two dominoes, and the last flip can only be used on one. This will happen sometimes three to five times in a row! Also with the puzzle and the trail game, it is next to impossible to complete to the end without spending money!

The game is addicting but it's almost impossible to play more then a couple rounds at a time due to the cost of each round and the amount they reward makes it impossible to get ahead unless you spend a lot of money! Your rewards don't always get credited I noticed on one of the trails the trail present that I landed on didn't credit me and that wasn't the first time! I love the graphics & the character!

i enjoy the game but absolutely agree with everyone else about the constant pop-ups. they're super annoying! also, i wish you got something for the end of events if you have remaining items. for example, if I have extra puzzle pieces, food from baskets, or axes, give me coins or let me keep them. it's maddening when i have a ton of items, but not enough to use them for something and BOOM. New rounds start, and I lose the items I worked hard to get!

Mixed feelings...mentally challenging but expensive if you want to get ahead. I have played it for months and am changing my ratings. It does give you money each hour, but if you need help, you have to purchase more dominoes for twice as much money as got. When you purchase tokens, and I did, you end up in the hole. Right now, the game offers opportunities to get points in other ways, but to get the extra, you need to purchase something. I have purchased extra dominoes and with no matches.

Would be fun but the incessant pop ups for all the different "events" and "deals" are awful. I guess it's supposed to be better than an ad but it's actually worse. This time I opened the game to EIGHT different little pop up ads. Just to collect the bonus points cause I don't have enough to play a round and continue, which is another thing. It feels like they set the randomization so you lose and need to BUY coins to play. Too bad. It would be fun to play otherwise.

At the start it's decent, but climbing up the levels it starts getting ridiculous. Going through the majority of the dominos you have to not have anything matching, and you have to use more coins to get only three extra dominoes, which you can't even use. It's ridiculous. It's not the difficulty of the levels, it's having to go through so many tiles in your hand to find out there's nothing you need, and then waste coins on three tiles, which none are even usable, and then more are needed.

Game seems like a cash grab. It's a lot of fun, I love the concept. I am not a fan of how hard it is to play without spending money to progress. You need to tons of coins (that cost real money) or you're only able to play once an hour. I love the little mini games they have but they don't last long enough to make progress in when you're only able to play once an hour. I do appreciate the chapters that you do in the game, but earning one star a level makes it take FOREVER to progress.

Love the game, it's cute how you go from level to level decorating the areas. However, you need an immense amount of coins to play a level, to buy extra cards etc and that's just not something you have. Also, when you start the game they literally give you about 8 pop ups that you have to close before being able to go to the main menu. That's just way too much.

Terrible game. The game itself is decent, but everything surrounding it is a huge cash grab. You need coins to play each level, and you barely get any for free. The only way to get more coins is to check in on the app EVERY HOUR, for a tiny amount. It doesn't stack up if you're not using the app for multiple hours. There's no option to watch ads for free coins or anything. Not to mention the gameplay is entirely random. You can be extremely skilled and still need to buy power-ups to finish.

I gave this app a 2 because the game is a blast. Unfortunately I have spent a fortune but haven't learned my lesson after several times being so close to finishing the final puzzle to win a sizeable amount of coins, but the puzzle pieces stop coming! Another fine example is needing a 4 or 7 to complete a hand. I will have 12 cards left, but there is no 4 or 7. Now I understand this, but when I purchase an extra 3 cards, 2 times and still fail...I don't want to continue. DO NOT GET ATTACHED!

Feels rigged at times. I went through so much gold at the end of rounds because I couldn't get something playable. Update: Been playing for a few weeks now. Definitely lose more than win. You have to spend so much gold to get the last domino to win the game. That's where you lose more often than not. There have been moments when I flip over 6 unplayable dominoes in a row. It is a great concept and has potential to be fun, but it seems more discouraging than anything. I'm uninstalling it.

Once you get far enough, it can take a dozen tries to actually solve a puzzle. You also only get enough coins for one puzzle every hour that don't build up, so you have to log on every hour to get your coins - if you don't collect them for 10 hours you still only get one hour/ one round worth of coins. If you get stuck on a puzzle, which as you progress happens frequently, it makes the game significantly less enjoyable and you can barely play a few minutes a day at that point.

We need more, pay for this, pay for that screens at startup. 7 screens to click through just ain't enough. Would make it 20 if you can!! But seriously, its a fun game, but why so Many screens to make you pay up. Just select one or 2 at random, this is just cheap and has the opposite effect, of never ever giving you guys anything. Edit: you did it, 13 screens to click through before one can play, congrats!

The gameplay is fun and the graphics are cute, but everything else about it is incredibly annoying. If you're out of coins, you can only try to win the current level once per hour until your luck finally improves. Then there are all the pop-ups and unskippable animations! The pop-ups get especially annoying when you're stuck on a level, seeing as all you can do after closing them is try exactly once and then you're done for another hour.

Unless you pay money, don't expect to reach any endpoints to earn credits. as soon as you get close, a time limit is placed on finishing. Also, You can't just watch ads in order to keep playing. You can check in every hour to get ONE PLAY! Ridiculous. You get to spin a wheel when you get through 30 levels, but the wheel sometimes only gives tiny prizes. I loved this game, but now I'm done with it. Uninstalling

Domino Dreams was mostly an enjoyable, colourful and challenging game. There were various opportunities to obtain more coins throughout the game. However, it reached a point where you literally have to spend money almost every day just to continue to play. That ruined the experience. Spending a little money now and again is fine, but Domino Dreams made it excessive. Uninstalled and will not play again.

It's a very visual pleasing game, and I enjoy the characters, but as others have said, it's very pushy at getting you to make in game purchases. Some days when I open the app, I need to exit through 11 different prompts for events and boosters just to collect my hourly play coins. I also don't see any reason to ever double down on my games when you can't even double the star points you need to progress the chapters. I also dislike the guilt tripping they do for events when you end/lose the match

The game is relatively fun, but I have a few gripes. Opening the game and between levels, I am BOMBARDED with offers to Buy this! Buy this! Buy this! How about this offer? Buy this! I don't spend money on games anyway, but this makes sure I never will. It's also hard to earn enough coins to play levels without actual money, because some levels are just difficult and almost require spending your coins to pass, and since you only earn so many you run out quicker. Overall fun, but a few gripes.

It's a good game and lots of fun. The only problem I'm running into is the fact that a lot of times the coins you win for completing a level are less than the coins you need to play the next level. The winnings should be at the minimum the price of the level and then bonus for the extra cards or however the bonuses are calculated. It's a losing battle to be able to play since you lose even when you win. Especially the further into the game you get. It's disappointing.

This game is fun but is programmed like any other game.... to encourage you to spend money. Every upper level is designed to give you the dominoes you need until the last one for the bonus. So you have to decide if you want the bonus or reset it. Same for the last domino on the board before completing a level... use coins or restart the level. So, no matter what you do, you are never ahead of where you started and need to spend money to keep playing. Even if you pick every domino correctly.

The game was fun in the beginning, and the promotion seemed interesting and doable 180 levels later, and money spent, im finding out it's pay to win. Tiles aren't showing up in sequence as they should some not at all. Hours I've spent just to reach the next level, and they just get longer and are designed to be difficult or not winnable, so you will buy. i will reach area 5 and get my .25 after that,I'm uninstalling. By the time I reach area 7 the burning rewards will probably be what I've spent

I have been playing this game for a while and I really enjoy it. The only thing I have issues with is that sometimes i earn things from certain events, I don't actually get them. It has been happening with the mountain explorer where I get coins and they aren't added to my bank or don'tappear until hours later. I really do like this game, but not getting the rewards is sometimes disappointing.

Update: The game is fun. There are a lot of side plays/games, howver, it doesn't seem like they give you enough time or coins/objects to win the Grand Prizes. I'm starting to notice like other players that some levels are impossible to win unless played 5-6 times. Ive lost $100K ($2400 per play) within a week just trying to level up. I think I will delete once I get to level 200.

Great aninations and graphics pretty cute. But this game very quickly turns into a pay to play game. This game is out to get you, when you have a tile left and blow through all of the tiles to choose from and none match. Not only losing the level but making you spend a crazy amount coins for a new set just to lose again. The cost to enter a level is way too high for the reward to be so low. Can barely make it to couple rounds of playing before im out of coins. This game not reccommend.

Like Dice Dreams, the ads and popups are everywhere. Most of the time the game makes it impossible to complete the games without paying real money first. You gain certain items for challenges and soon after, the challenges end without any rewards being given. There are plenty of bugs and you often miss out on the rewards you've earned. It can take weeks of playing several times a day to complete a chapter. Unless you want to pay a fortune in real money. It had potential, but they ruined it.

The game itself is really fun. But you run out of coins quick because the payout coins when you win are minimal & coins to play the game are high. Plus the boosters are high. So you end up not being able to play...unless you pay. Which is another thing, there are TONS of pop-ups wanting you to buy coins, etc. It makes it disappointing when you have a fun game to play but it's ruined by greediness. 😕 Probably won't be playing it much longer at this rate!!!

thus far a decent game concept. typical shop push. Haven't encountered a hard pay wall, but I can see someone who is bad at the game dropping money. Edit: I have some advice for the team. The shop pushing is excessive. Upon opening the app, I am usually greeted with at least seven shop pop ups, but have seen it go as far as nine. The core gameplay is fun, but, again, with the shop push, in the form of aggressive replay pricing and power ups. It's what keeps you from being a hit. Do better.

I came on here yo say EXACTLY what everyone is saying. When I first downloaded it I really enjoyed it. It is a lot of fun. But once you run out of coins (which happens quickly because you win less than you spend on many rounds) it is impossible to play. I played dice dreams and you get tonnes of bonuses, but this game if you don't get the 2000 every hour, it doesn't even accumulate. I hope they change it to be more like dice dreams. PLEASE ADD THE OPTION OF WATCHING AD'S FOR COINS!!

Almost reached my goal...and then crash. I was playing Monday morning, went to work, went on break and boom...stuck in an infinite loading screen loop. It's been around 30 hours since I first noticed. I found this game through Pogo and have been thoroughly enjoying it...until now. Was literally on my last few levels to complete the chapter I needed and now I'm going to end up running out of time. If that happens, I'm just going to delete. I want something consistent, looks like this game isn't

It's a Domino game. I'd love to give more stars but so many levels start right off with no available moves. Forcing you to use coins and what little resources you have to get through levels. I know it's supposed to be challenging but that's not a mental challenge in my opinion when it leaves you no choice but to pay to keep playing because there are no available moves from start to finish! It's games like these that I refuse to give 1¢ to! Paying to play should be an option NOT a necessity!

I loved the game, very addictive. However, suddenly this morning the amount of coins to play a single round went from a little over 9,000 coins to 30,000! Seriously!? I've spent too much money simply because I enjoyed the game. I think I'm done after this though. absolutely ridiculous. $5 per "package" and you get maybe one play on the lowest level. Upgrading to the the 4th level to get the most bonus items $230,000. Not worth it. Update: seemed to be a glitch, fixed itself

This game is bogus! It gets increasingly harder, and the algorithm to get the right tiles is rigged. You want the players to spend money to continue with the levels, and it doesn't even matter because you lose the coins when you play each level and don't get back as much when you complete the levels. The stars to complete the chapters are too much, and you are not able to achieve them that fast. I would suggest improving the game to be more enjoyable for the players.

Not worth your time. Fun for the first hundered levels or so but after a few chapters it becomes a cash grab. Have to log in every hour for coins, and it takes 2-5 hours to get enough coins for a level. A vast majority of the levels cannot be completed without spending additional coins on gold tiles later in the game, and if you use the additional tiles power up instead for less money, you will typically get 3 fresh tiles that still don't line up with your puzzle. 0/10, would not recommend.

Edit: Ok, played this game for a bit now and this is what I've learned. - Every game is not winnable, you could lose half of your dominos first thing. - Barely break even when winning. - Hourly reward to collect is JUST enough for one game. - Amount of popups and animations that has to play before you can move on is kinda silly. - Can't see how you'll be able to win the timed challenges without paying real money. It's a fun game but you hardly get to play it unless you spend money or get lucky

Definitely profit driven. You beat a level and are lucky if you manage to get 200 coins more than the cost of the level. The coin cost for wilds and 3 Xtra cards is ridiculous. The "rewards" for the trail and other events are a joke. Increasing your bet doesn't increase the amount of stars you get so it takes forever to complete a chapter. You have to come back every hour to collect the bonus just to try and save up enough to play a couple of games in a row.

This used to be one of my favorite games, but with every update, the rewards for finishing levels are less and less. There are too many "buy this pack" pop-ups (I counted 7 today when I opened the app). I spent a lot on this game because it was fun and worth it, but it's impossible to beat levels without spending a ton of coins on a wild card. I get around 4600 coins every hour (I think it's hourly), and it costs around 7000 to play a level. Deleting as soon as I hit the Post button.

Fun game. Unique gameplay. Cute animations. No ads. I would love to give it 5 stars, but I find it manipulative & pushy for people to spend money. Rather than having lives, it uses coins. At the beginning each game costs 1000. When you win you get the game cost back plus a bonus. But as you level up the costs get higher but the bonus stays the same, so you have less purchasing power. At level 182, game costs 2400. Every hour you get 1 game's worth of coins. Pushes you to buy coins to play more.

The game is fun and visuals are cute. However, it's a complete rip off. The higher you go, the more expensive it is to play but rewards don't match. If you happen to win some freebies in the game, the next few rounds are rigged so you use up all your freebies instantly. I downloaded this game to earn some free cash thru another app and their offers are a rip off too. Spend $599 in app to earn $30.

Game concept is fun, with the usual progressions of cards, scenes, and adventures that other games have. Wild cards and extra moves are too expensive and eventually you're not earning enough coins to continue playing and there is nothing you can do. no way to replenish coins other than purchase. other games make you wait a few hours for new lives (coins) but this one does not so you're eventually unable to continue playing

Frustratingly slow if you don't put down real money, and nearly impossible to get ahead with coins. If you do spend money, it's easy to spend more than you think. Bonuses, like extra dominoes and the golden domino, are WAY overpriced. Otherwise, addictive and fun! I find the animations very satisfying. Can also be frustrating to only have one domino left and a bunch in the draw pile, and NONE of them are a match. Sometimes, it feels like it was programmed that way on purpose to get you to spend.

It's fun at first, but after a couple of hours you reach a point where the hourly coins aren't enough to let you play a level. In the early levels, the hourly coins are enough to let you play, but as you progress, the coin return sadly does not increase. You have to remember to login for 5 hours just to get to play one level. This game is also heavily based on chance rather than skill. Levels often have a linear path, with no choices to make, and yet you still have to lose or pay money to win.

This game could easily be 5 stars. However you lose your coins and then you're waiting around to play a single round an hour. Would be nice to be able to actually play longer than 1 time an hour (because repeatedly I wait for the one round worth of coins and its rigged for failure!) And as far as purchase options, the coins to play the rounds are too pricey! Again, would be a 5 star game but if I can't play it then it's not worth having.

A usually fun game, but after playing for a while you can tell it has a pay to play model. Levels are often impossible without using some of the 'help' features (which cost in game coins), it's only when you run out of coins and don't play for a while then come back you all of a sudden easily pass the level because they have figured out you aren't going to make a purchase but want you to keep playing. Therefore it is really hard to when any of the in game competitions or quests without purchase.

The game is entertaining. Having no ads helps a lot, but hitting continue 25+ times on pop-ups for card quests, puzzles, and other side games was not. I just want to get to the game for a quick distraction. By the time I'm done hitting continue, i don't even want to play anymore.... update: un-installed. Pop-ups were still way too much.

Could be a great game, but the gold cost to reward ratio is way to small. At the levels I'm at. It coats roughly 2000 gold to start a level, then you're only awarded 2300 if you're lucky for winning. Then you have to pay for extra moves. 2300 for one extra set of moves (3 tiles) that may end up not matching anything on the field. Sometimes my entire starting hand doesn't match anything on the field. But I already wasted 2000 coins to play the mission!

it's a fun game, but expensive. Despite having a chance to get free coins every hour it never equals out to what you'll use. The higher the level, the more money you need, eventually you reach the point that even you've collected all the free coins you can in a 24 hour period, it may not be enough to play even one level. I'll be uninstalling it very soon.

Cute and fun. Great way to pass some time. I don't like how any bonus coins you win are deplenished very quickly. With each level, the cost of coins go up to play each game. The odds are stacked against you so that you lose and it's constantly in your face about wanting you to buy more coins with your real money. Umm no. I am playing this through the FreeCash app btw.

Only downloaded this game to get points on a rewards app. I was hoping it would at least be entertaining enough to make me want to come back to it, and I was coming back to it for play time for more rewards, but now I can hardly play for two minutes before I run out of coins. This app has a heavy emphasis on pay to play which makes me not want to come back to it. On top of that, each time you load the app, click on an event, or lose a level you get bombarded with ads to make in app purchases.

My initial review was positive, but after playing it to a level over 1300, I know the game is rigged against you. I love the game, but it's too expensive to continue to play. The cards you can buy are double the price of starting a new game, and it's only for 3 cards that don't seem to help anyway. I wish this was similar to their Dice Dreams. It's not rigged, and it has different ways to get extra dice. Domino Dreams is a great game but rigged and too expensive.

I originally would've rated this 5 stars, but then rated 3, well now I've come back to update this to one star. I really want to love this game. But it's ridiculous how much the levels cost compared to coins you win in playing them. The only way to get more coins is wait an hour for base level, purchase them, or win in-game challenges, but realistically the only way to win the challenges is to play using a higher level of coins which once you lose, you're then back to zero. I'd rather watch ads.

This game is more aggravating than relaxing. In order to go to the next chapter you have to collect stars and the only way to collect is to complete a level. For each level you only get 1 star. You aren't able to purchase stars or anything. Level 223, Chapter 7 is INSANE! Then it takes 3-9 stars just to complete 1 action. Don't waste you're money on this game. You pay for the extra coins then can lose them all trying to complete 1 level just to end up not being able to complete it anyway. Sucks

Im on level 3903. The only way to participate anymore is to either pay to play or long in every hour on the hour so by the end of the day so I have enough coins to play a higher level in order to participate in events, to get any items. And even then, most likely, I'll still only be able to play one or two boards. I've spent alot of money on this game. it's definitely fun in the beginning. But there is no incentive to be a daily supportive player. Uninstalling after years of play. Unfortunate.

Luck Based and Pay-to-win. I ran out of coins, so it's hard to make any progress at level 120 or so, at chapter 5. The game itself is mostly luck based. Even the few times where you have a choice of more than 1 possible move, the best move is random. Oh, and every time I open the app, there's 8 pop-ups for random deals that I have to close!

it was fun at first, but I'm pretty sure it's designed to force you to spend money to progress once you hit certain levels. I will have one domino left on the board and have 5+ tiles left to play and none of the tiles are playable?? the higher I go in the levels the more common this is. one time I had 10 tiles left and still nothing lmao. I haven't progressed in a while because I refuse to spend money every time I can't win a level. shouldn't be the point of the game.

The game (as many others) is designed so you make in app purchases to keep going. Nothing wrong with that, the issue is that many times the purchase gives an error and you are not rewarded or us partially rewarded. They take 1-2 business days to answer and when you actually get your reward, the challenge you were trying to win is over. So even tough they give you the rewards it is simply too late and you end up losing many other rewards you could've gotten.

fun, but predatory in it's monetisation.just play for free, don't give in to the system. Update as a response: the game rarely feels like a puzzle game at all, which it should be. But when you are limited on your abilities to finish a level, just because you have to pay up or wait a few hours, it diminishes the enjoyment. You rarely feel like you can pick up the game and play a few levels, because you're always stopped by a pay/wait-wall.

I want to love it, but the game very quickly becomes pay to win. The amount of coins required for each level is too high and it just keeps going up the more levels you do. It's awful to sometimes have to spend 50k+ coins to finish a level. Also, I wish that all the duplicate cards would be worth something instead of just disappearing into the abyss. I get sooooo many dupes that I wish could be coins or traded for power ups or something!

Gameplay is decently enjoyable, but the obvious money grabbing decisions are very off-putting. Playing a game costs coins, and winning a game barely gives you enough for another level, so you end up not being able to play at all unless you pay. Add to that the absurd number of popups when you open the game trying to sell you "boosts" and "bonuses", I do not recommend this game.

As others have pointed out, the game is pretty much pay to play. The amount of coins you get per hour is just enough to cover one round, and unlike other games they don't accumulate while you're away so you have to check in and collect them hourly. It's hard to get coins without spending money, and several times now I've had purchases glitch and not give me all the stuff I paid for. The animations are cute but the costs make it almost unplayable.

I originally left a 5 star review as this has been my favorite game for a long time. But a few things have happened recently that are making me really annoyed. (this next part might not make sense if you do not play, so sorry about that🤣) there is a side game where you collect ingredients and complete recipes to earn coins. Today during the chefs twist game I earned a golden basket with a rare ingredient and it was taken away and I never got it. I'm very annoyed. Other than that it's still fun.

The cost to play each round is ridiculous. The in game "helpers" aren't worth the cost either. The price continues to go up after levels but the ability to gain coins remains limited. It feels like you have to pay real money to actually succeed consistently. I also haven't received the rewards from FB messenger in weeks. Every time I click on it the game says I'm offline and check later. I close the game and come back and then it states the gift has already been claimed.

Great, but you can't play at one point. I actually enjoyed this game for awhile, until I wasn't able to afford paying for the next level. This game highly depends on coins, which is completely fine... but I feel as though they're forcing us to pay actual cash to keep playing. That's just my opinion. Overall! Great game, but you can't play because you need a lot of coins to buy next levels. (Please take away the coins! I just wanna play :"""")

This game is very cash-grabby and if you're trying to avoid becoming a cash whale this isn't the game for you. The gameplay is pretty addictive though, and can kill time if you've got some to waist. My biggest complaint for the game ultimately is the amount of popups for limited time events and sales every time you launch the game. There will always be at least 7 or 8 popups at any given time before you can get to any actual gameplay and this is more obnoxious than informative.

One of the slowest moving games that I have ever played. Sure, starting out, I went like gangbusters, but as you get into the later levels, things get harder. They don't give you the Domino's that you need, and the coins that you get barely cover the buy in for the game. After only a handful of losing games, you're pretty much done for a while. This is very much a pay to play game

I'm slowly understanding how to make the right plays. I gave in and made a purchase ($1.99) in order to keep playing. I was supposed to advance and get more tokens/stamps(?) which were free but After the purchase it brought me back to the game. I reached a point where I could choose to purchase more coins which connected me to two free options, and I realized I was not given my free ones from before. Not happy!!!

The game is alright starting out, but once you get into the later levels the game all but demands you pay for more coins in order to play. The cost to play each level steadily increases, the rewards for completing each level are often not at least equal to the cost going in. Woe to those who dare try for the Mega or Epic games. The game RNG tends to go out of its way to shortchange the player at every turn, as well, which means you're going lose coins no matter what you do.

I have found this game to fun, fair, and engaging. it will make your mind run wild with process of deductive reasoning. However, I don't enjoy that you are almost pressured into spending when stuck on a level for so long. Also it stinks that you must spend coins just unlock a puzzle, it makes you barely break even if you use no power ups. overall it again has been fun to me.

I want to like it. It's nice that I don't have to deal with ads. Instead it is money hungry by having a huge RNG that makes it possible to have levels that are completely unsolveable without using coins, which makes them disappear fast. Plus every game you play costs 1500 coins just to attempt. Overall it's a game I want to like but just can't have fun with because of my coins always being gone or balancing on a knife's edge. The fact that you can start a level with 0 moves sucks.

A good concept with one glaring issue; the game is pay to play. You run out of coins extremely fast, the cost to starting a level being incredibly high. There are few ways to get coins for free. Instead you are pressured into spending real life money to play more than 3 minutes at a time. If the devs lower the cost of a level or give more free coins, I'll edit my review.

Domino Nightmare! This game has zero progression, has way too many pop up purchase opportunities, way too many cut scenes that are way too slow.
