There are also an ungodly amount of side games that are not core to the Domino game itself, but required to get you the cash you need for new levels, wild cards, or extra cards. They are dumb. Why should I care about feeding an animal? It has nothing to do with the game. If you enjoy being frustrated and hating the games you play, get this one! 0 *s

I can only give this two stars for the simple fact that it's really hard really fast, and the paywall you hit becomes apparent really quick. It was actually really fun and graphics were good, opening ads were a bit excessive but dealable. The fact that it "cost" so much to play each hand makes it almost impossible to get anywhere unless you pay. When I did pay, it only extended my game for about 15 minutes.

This was really fun for the first few chapters but the further along you get it gets really bad! The price to play keeps going up and up but purchase options and prize amounts remain the same so you go through coins SO fast. The levels are also really hard as you move on. I have to play some levels upwards of 10 times to pass it. I just went through 100,000 coins on 3 levels and only passed 2 of them. It sucks all the fun out of the game when even making purchases can't get you very far.

The game is impossible to play without making purchases as you advance, and the prices get more and more insanely expensive with each purchase you make - like a doubled price for maybe 1.2× the amount of stuff. Not only that, but there are FREQUENT errors when you do make purchases. Not receiving items, items suddenly becoming unavailable to redeem Franklin Bucks for, etc. And if you contact support, they just play dead for a week or so before responding, and never actually do anything. SCAM!!!

I loved this game in the beginning but it's really hard to keep any coins after a while. I feel like it purposely makes you lose for 2 days straight so your forced to buy coins which I won't waste money on. I just think the amount of coins you get every hour should be higher cause you can't buy the things to assist you cause their way higher then the level cost.

I want to like the game. While it is unique, decently enjoyable and ad free- it uses "coins" to play each level. Thus, you eventually run out and either have to buy one of the packages that they intensely push at you, or wait hours to get more. The 2000 coins per game is nothing more than a ploy to force people to pay for those packages. Otherwise, why have it in there? The coin aspect is pointless! It makes this VERY simple game not really worth the hour+ wait to play a 60 second round...

Decided to buy the Kings Pass. It is 31 days of prizes as you play. I believe it cost $15. Each stage required a few more puzzles to finish. Like 5 day one, 10 day 2 etc. On Day 30, it took 44 puzzles to complete and I was excited because I was expecting 50 puzzles to complete and I still had 36 hours to finish. Last stage required ....720 puzzles!!!! Seriously! THAT IS RIDICULOUS! fun game with ridiculous requirements!

If you're trying to win a bonus on another app, this is NOT the game for you. No matter how good you are and how many levels you go through, there's entirely too much to muddle through just to complete each chapter. I started Domino Dreams a month and a half ago and I'm not even on chapter nine yet! Kash Kick is only giving me another three weeks to get to chapter 40! (I've made mulitple purchases for coins and other aids to get through the game.) I'm uninstalling it now. 👎👎👎👎👎

It was fun at first, but the longer you play the more it prompts you to make purchases to actually continue. You can wait an extended periods of time for free rolls but it really slows the progress and takes the fun out of the game. It pushes "offers" for in game purchases every time you run out of dice rolls. And there are often like 4-5 different offers that pop up. Remove the pop ups for offers. If people want them they will look for them. It really takes away from the experience.

Game is fun but every time I open the game, I'm spammed with all the events popping up in my face. Very annoying when I'm trying to claim my hourly coins. Please stop this. Also kinda annoying that I have to wait an hour to try the game again..please have more options to get coins (Example, watching ads) and make the events last a little longer. They only last a couple days when you can barely play for free with the hour wait to try the level again. Please fix this and I will change my rating.

This game has promise, but it's squandered here. It's too luck-driven. When the tiles line up will, it's actually pretty fun, but it's possible to run into unsolvable runs. You could even start out with an unusable piece and not draw a suitable piece for a while, wasting so many turns on nothing. It's manageable with tiles numbered 0-6, but they add more tiles so that you hope for a 1-in-10 chance to get what you need. I wouldn't be surprised if more tile types get added. It got old quickly.

Once you start getting into the game it stops being fun because of how little you actually get to play and you win even less than that. So it's more like a slow downhill slope until you are pinching pennies just to lose all the time. In order to beat the levels you need to use in game help which costs waaay too many coins. I also don't like how there's all these pop up interruptions between every single level. Basically, it could've been a great game, but was designed to make me hate it instead.

No ads, that's nice, not really though. It means ur forced to pay to play, instead of watching an ad to play, or play something else and wait an hour to play a single round 😒. I also noticed around lvl 90+ they added more of the dominos with the same image...I think. They need to add more ways to play without paying ..or just stop playing...got it they don't want ppl to actually play the game. Just delete it.. I mean, that's what theyre saying, right?!

The basic gameplay is alright. It's just matching dominoes. But there is so much extra going on that it feels unnecessary. There's a bunch of different currencies. You have to spend in-game currency to play the next level, and it almost feels like the game is going out of it's way to force you to use the currency you earn so you need to pay for more. I am only playing this to earn points in another app, so once I hit my next milestone, I am done.

most of the time, I can only play 5 or 10 mins at a time. They give you so the cost of the game is not much more than the long in bonus. And they make it hard to complete around. So 55-65% of the time,I get one round than it's over. I know they do this to push people into purchasing coin packages. But I'm not the one to do that. Actually, when they make it so obvious I 100% promise I won't buy coins. Too bad, too, because it is a fun game and I probably would make in app purchases if not for it.

The game was going just fine in the beginning. After the last update it began to crash a lot and now I can't even load it. I am getting the error message," Oops something went wrong. Please restart." I have contacted support but I haven't received anything back as of yet. I have made in app purchases and am currently playing this on Freecash as an offer, which is time limited. Please fix this bug and run another update! I have seen reading the reviews I am not alone with this issue.

Game is fun to play. Adorable graphics. I gave it 2 stars because the in-app purchases have failed 4 times this far. They take the money, and only give me a portion of the items that were supposed to be provided, the free items that are supposed to unlock don't unlock. Also there's been a couple of times I was to earn a reward that didn't load. I contacted the developers in which they asked for receipts then never responded again.

Game play is fine. No issues with it. But I grew up playing dominoes since I could count and these weird fruit pieces really throw off game play. The whole point of dominoes is their are a set number of each piece, but not in this game so it's hard to know which piece to play. And if you guess the wrong play it's almost like the game purposely makes rest of the pieces in your hand unplayable. I give it a 3 because it's only fun for a while. Fun in concept but doesn't translate in real life

Very addicting game, but full of issues yet no options to give a bug report. Game is wildly inconsistent, with the rewards being either too much to afford so you will need to spend money on it to get somewhere. The puzzle pieces that need to be collected, when it is normally on your first frame 1 digit puzzles that needs to be collected but can double triple often. It's impossible to collect all the cards before the time runs out and you always get the same ingredients in baskets. Inconsistent!

I was having fun until all the sudden a round ended... and when I go back to the homepage, a majority of my achievements had been lost. it took me back to the very start of the Temple jewels pickaxe. Then on the puzzles it took me back to the very first puzzle even though I had been on puzzle 10. I'm really pissed off right now. I played and achieved all of those and now it's got me starting back at the very beginning. This is not the first time, but first time I was only a few levels in.

They force you to make a purchase or you have to wait every hour to collect a tiny bonus (you have to collect many of these) because there's no option to get any for watching ads or another option. With their other games it was not like that. It's annoying to wait for hourly tiny bonuses and level rewards are equal the cost of the next level! So actually you pay every time all your winnings and during the game you usually spend more winnings (in a lucky option - you just don't spend anything).

This game is very difficult to progress in. It is very luck based as well. There are many luck based games around and some are enjoyable. This one is not enjoyable whatsoever. It is "pay to play" and no one can deny it. The rewards are unable to compensate for the money I put in. This results in my coins being depleted at breakneck speeds. Also, why so many stars? It feels so excessive for a game like this. Either make the dominos level more consistent (similar generations) or lower the price.

The game itself is fun and quite addictive. My issue is that it is way too expensive to play. There is no option to watch ads or similar if you're short of coins. There are things like daily rewards and spinning the wheel, completing puzzles etc. But you have to win 30 rounds to spin the wheel. Puzzles, the tomb game etc you will never complete without buying packs over and over. You get 1 puzzle piece for winning a round. Some slots in the puzzle take over 200 pieces.

Junk game. Forces you to spend coins at an exponential rate. It costs 1k coins to start a level. If you're lucky, you'll get 1.4k coins for a level completion. Wild cards get expensive fast, easily topping 1k after a few uses. If you quit a level, you lose 1.5k coins. Everything you do will cause you to outspend what you gain from a level completion. This is just a micro transaction app to purchase coins to progress.

I really liked this game at first, no ads and very addictive to play. However, the further advanced you get in the levels, the more expensive it is to complete. You almost always need to use coins to buy extra dominoes or wild cards to complete a level. The basic level also doesn't give you as much perks to complete any side games. I appreciate getting daily gifts and coins every hour but I find myself logging in every hour to collect coins just to play one level.

You couldn't pay me to keep playing this game. I tried it out for the free cash app, and the amount of menu pop ups offering in game purchases is overwhelming. I dreaded just opening the app but, was trying to make a few extra bucks by playing through free cash. Ended up uninstalling even with high cash back rewards. I couldn't stomach it. Super annoying.

NOT WORTH IT- This game may not have 'ads' but it sure does ask you for money 6 times before you can even collect your hourly bonus. There are a million 'sales' but not a single one gives you enough currency to play for more than a few hours. Every single round of the game costs more and more as you play, and sometimes you need a specific tile to start the level, and it won't be in your hand. Shameless money grab, do not play, it's frustrating and greedy

Fun game to kill time. Only set back is the amount of coins to progress is far more than what you receive completing the level you are on. If you end the game then any progress made on any of the side multipliers is lost. The amount of pop ups on new events just to get to play when opening up the app is ridiculous. Get rid of the pop ups. I'm sure 99.99999% of players are capable of tapping on the events if we want to participate in them.

I think it's a decent game, but the the progress in the game is terrible. The more chapters you unlock, the more money you lose. First time I had the game I barely made it a quarter Into chapter 2 before running out of coins. So I unistalled then reinstalled to try again, and that time I got MUCH farther. Basically you have to try not to undo too much and not waste money on those gold dominoes. But still the game finds a way to stuck out coins making you wait hours to get enough coins to enjoy.

Points system sucks!! By chapter 9, you literally LOSE money just by playing a level. The levels currently cost 3200 coins and if you finish with no dominos left, you get about 3000. 😱 Not to mention the 7300 coins it takes to get help with the level. The rewards for finishing levels should be a LOT higher. I only got this far by spending TONS of money on bonuses. The game itself is fun, but the amount of money you need to spend makes you not even want to bother.

My only real complaint is that there is no option to earn coins by watching ads or completing tasks. Once you run out of coins, if you don't want to or can't pay for more, you're stuck waiting until the next bonus comes, which is up to an hour later. Meaning if you fail a level, and you're out of coins, you're stuck waiting an hour before you can do anything else. Otherwise, it's great. Until none of your available tiles match any of the ones you draw on the bottom.

The RNG is complete garbage, you could play a level over and over and NEVER get the numbers you need. So after awhile, you run out of coins to keep trying and have to wait an hour for an amount that doesn't always let you try again. Completing chapters takes way too many points to level up. Also, way too many pop ups trying to get you to purchase a bundle.

The game concept isn't bad, but the rewards are barely more than it costs to play a level. You either end up logging in all the time to collect an hourly reward or spending cash to play. The game is overly monetized. Never less than 3 or 4 things they are trying to sell you. The in game events are too short, usually 1 or 2 days, and often require you to win 20-30 levels to hit the goals. For a game that is as much luck as skill, it's just not well balanced.

At some point the game algorithmically tries to squeeze money out of you every chance it gets. I played three rounds in a row where the start up domino was unusable. I run out of coins just trying to finish a level. I'm on chapter 3. Level 48. Ran out of coins to play. 5 stars on a task is ridiculous at this rate. Costing in game coins to play a level is not good. I'd rather you stick to lives. Stunting my play on purpose is rude. All of this makes the game a chore.

This is the worst game ever. It's a shameless scam. Not a game. Games give a fair deal. The Dominoes have no set. As in there can be 3 of the same but none of the ones you need . But here's where the scam comes in. They run events constantly that give you prizes for completing multiple levels in a row on the first try. But they rig the games to lose so they can pressure you into spending money to keep you place in the events. You can't win buy playing better. I'm getting paid to play and I quit

The "free" items are not free. They'll lead you to a purchase. The app is a one function at a time app. It doesn't matter how many times you hit the button for your hourly bonus, the app will not release it until has has taken you through their "bonus sales". And it will not remember any sound settings. As I switch between my Bluetooth devices I have to reset my no sound settings. But not before the app shows all the sales. This game is totally meant to make money. Cute characters, kind of a

First of all, this game is fun... at first. It feels like a good "match the pips" domino game. But then, you get deeper in and find out you can't play like you'll want to without spending absurd amounts of money to buy coins. The fact that you have to pay 2K coins just to start a level makes the insane randomness during the game hard to fathom. Development team, this game is too dang expensive to play everyday. Please lower the coin requirements. It's ridiculous.

**Update** I've decided to drop the stars down to 2. The game was fun for awhile, but that is by design: to reel you in with a small window of success and then here comes the advanced AI where you constantly lose your credits to the point where the game is no longer playable. It turns into a pay-to-win model eventually (should've seen that coming). If you don't mind microtransactions and you have money to blow, then this game is for you.

Its fun at first but you get to about level 55 and they game takes a 2 to 3 tries just to go to the next level and your so out of coins that the timer is set for an hour each time before you can play again. Seems like it sets you up for failure. Everytime I play it I feel sad that it just once and then an hour which if your an adult it could take 2 to 3 days before you remember it again. Kinda sucks.

I really love how this game plays but it takes so many coins to play a level, add cards, use a wild card, etc that it takes forever to progress in the game. The rewards from completing a level give you just enough coins to play one more level. And it's frustrating that, if you don't collect your coins every hour, they don't accumulate. I'd lower the cost of these things to give players more time in the game before they run out of coins - and let the coins accumulate to a certain amount.

Just play with real dominos. It is incredibly difficult to advance without spending money. More often than not the first third of dominos that come up don't match anything. The cost to play each level is very near to how much you get for winning levels, so you run out of coin way faster than you earn it. It has too many pop-ups and no way to make them stop. It's frustrating beyond belief when you just want to play a game but have to go through a bunch of pop-ups first.

The ONLY positive is there's no ads. Other than that, I wouldn't recommend this game. Frequently a round will start w/ absolutely nothing to do. Fine, whatever. But numerous times, at the VERY start, you have to go through 4 or 5 tiles before you can even do anything! Also, many times the last 3-4 tiles have NOTHING to do w/ ANY bottom tiles. There's been times where I had 6 tiles left in stack, 1 tile on board, and NOTHING matched. Makes you feel like you have a chance when you actually don't

This game is poorly designed. The actual gameplay is a good idea, but at a certain point, the levels cost way too many coins to play. Once the player is low on coins, the player will have to either remember to log in every hour to get the minimal coins to play once, or save up the coins to then prevent one-self from losing the level. This is egregious, considering the loss rate becomes quite high. From there, the decision is to wait again or give in and spend money to win.

It's a great game but I have a huge problem with the fact that it I spend money to get 120,000 coins with a couple helpers from a package and the first game eats all of them away and the next round doesn't let me advance for 6 straight attempts taking everything. And I support the game every week it's like there just trying to get more out of me. Others may have different experiences but they can forget getting anything else out of me.

fun to play, but I don't recommend it. The rewards are very cheap and few and far between. each level Takes more coins and more stars to complete and in the higher levels. Each level is set up to force you to buy. There is zero chance of collecting coins, Without spending money. It is purely a grift to force you to buy more and more and more. To say it is free to play is misleading As it is basically a pay to play game. 👎 I un-installed this game.

Waiting an hour to play 1 hour to play one game for free is annoying. At level 46, I ended up paying for coins/cheats and SURPRISE! I ended up losing everytime until I ran out of coins. It's a fun game. Wish it didn't have an algorithm to try and make you continue to PAY to play.... or wait an hour for only enough to play one game you're almost guaranteed to lose because they know/want you to spend money. Not to mention, I count 6 "offers" before play.

Thought this game was fun and that there would be nothing that could ruin the experience. But of course, just like every other microtransaction game, eventually the algorithm(no playable combination to win a level no matter how hard you try) forced me to lose consistently enough to run out of coins. Thus forcing me to have to spend money if I want to continue playing at the current moment or wait an hour for more coins. Once I complete the objectives I need to on freecash, I will be uninstalling

I have had a few problems with this game. Foremost is purchasing the Dream Pass and not receiving it, thought it hadn't gone through so did it again and still never received it. I contacted support through the game a couple times and have not heard back from them at all. At this point I want my 2 purchases of $2.99 refunded. Second is the game lags heavily from the amount of extras that are being advertised. Slow to open and then slow play.

It is impossible to progress at times as you're given few opportunities to earn coins, and you can end up needing to attempt a level time and time again- mind you, coins are required to continue completing levels. it's unfortunate that this fact is not abundantly clear at the start of the game. You'll have fun for a bit, absolutely - but soon, you'll realize the game is set up to make you spend real cash constantly.

The gameplay is great if I had coins to play. You get tons of coins from levels 1-100 after that your basicly Sitting at nothing. You get I think 2500, enough for 1 round, per hour for free, but the game has to be open to claim. It should be automatic. Get if your looking for a few fun hours after that delete it. 1 star for forcing monetization just to play. You need to do better. Respect your players time and money.

Always screenshot/notate purchases. This game is super cute. You may find yourself wanting to make purchases. I spent money, got an error message, didn't receive the items, and was still charged. It took 4 days for support to respond, and I believe it was only because I sought out and emailed and left this originally poor review. They asked for a lot of proof and luckily, I write down descriptions and keep receipts. enjoy the game, but protect yourself if you're going to do in app purchases.

NO ADS! That's my favorite thing about this game. I know that's how y'all make your money but I'm so sick of playing quick level games that have an ad EVERY LEVEL. Seriously, that's such a turn on for me that I won't feel guilty for spending money on this game. The levels are not too easy, not too difficult. You get a sufficient chunka money to keep you playing for hours! Graphics are beautiful and no crazy amount of popups every time you load in! I would highly recommend this game!

was 5, now 1. they began to force me to spend premium to finish stages. It's not even a puzzle at this point, you'll most of the time be one piece away from completing a level, so you think "ohhh I almost got it!!!", but in fact that's what they intentionally do to make you purchase, this is how they make money, pieces are not random. First two maps are fun, after that they clearly put a paywall in your face.

I have played over a thousand levels of this game, but I can't say I enjoy it. The game is aggressively monetized. When opened, it will flash many pop ups enticing you to spend money. It's easy to fall victim to levels you can't beat due to rng, and it will ask you to spend money to buy currency to keep playing every time. The devs of this were not interested in making a game. They wanted to make a Skinner Box people could put money in to get a hit of dopamine. Don't play this. It's not worth it

The game is fun and I like it. However, the price to play is too high. I dont mind paying coins to play, but I dont think it's fair that the price to play goes up every level I go up. It should stop at a certain point. It's taking the fun away from me. Im stressing about having enough coins to play, and that 7.99 ads up because I keep running out of coins too fast, too quick. The price to pay needs to be fair.

Fun at first, now DELETED! I got a 10 minute free round card that didn't last anywhere near 10 minutes so, I tried support. They claimed they sent me something but that's absolutely not true. I told them this, even followed up a couple days later and am still being ignored. I tried to keep my coins up, won lots of little prizes here and there but many rounds simply don't provide the tiles you need WITHOUT spending a huge amount of coins or making a purchase. Developer response is laughable. 🙄

There is only one form of currency - coins. You don't have lives, each round you play takes coins. The boosts also require coins but at 4x the cost of playing a single round. You will be limited to about 30-minutes max gameplay unless you purchase more coins at an unbelievable cost. If rounds cost lives instead of coins, this would be a much more enjoyable game and would retain players for longer periods of time. Also, 6 friends joined and played from my invite but I was never sent the rewards.

So-so, its a fun game to pass the time with, but I wish the free hourly coins/tokens you get rollover. you can only collect the coins when youre actively in the game instead of adding up. Ex, you collect 2000 coins one hour then are away for three hours, when you return you only collect 2000 coins instead of being able to collect 6000. The game is favorable setup to force you to buy coins to play to advance further in the game.

I love this game, and have been playing it daily for almost 2 years. However... Lately it is about impossible to win or get ahead without buying anything. Every update makes it harder. To make things even more annoying, I made a purchase yesterday that I did not receive, and messaged support 3 times without any response. Today, if you try to message support, it says the game needs to restart then my phone goes blank. I sent an email, so I'll see if I hear back, if not, I will no longer play.

Sucks. Won't let you progress without spending real money. Games are rigged to make you keep losing until you pay for a package which never gets you very far, you'll be lucky to win two games with it before the algorithm rigs the game again so that you spend even more money. You can go a whole game without a single match and then have to wait an hour just to obtain the exact amount of coins to play a round and, of course, lose. Side quests are a waste of time and gives you bare minimum prizes.

Enjoy playing but absolutely hate the constant push to buy addition coins, energy, etc. Pay to play--- it's as if you're not allowed to continue unless you buy the additional items. There are free items listed but only if you purchase first. It's not a lot but will certainly add up over time. I refuse to be suckered in. If it gets to the point I can't continue the game I will uninstall and move on to other games.

At first the game seems fun because you can actually, in a way, "solve a puzzle" by dictating which dominos are the best to flip to win.... Then after level 3 you start to realize the game dictates your progression, and it purposefully doesn't give you what you need to succeed... Kind of like, you know, gambling.. Just to make it harder for you to complete the levels so you don't earn the reward on the cash apps. Purposeful design, they wanna get paid first.

It is a good game especially if you like Dominoes of course. Make sure in the very beginning to try and not use up your coins because the amount rises every time you use them and go really fast. So even if it seems like you have a lot they go too fast and then you will be stuck and not be able to go any further until you either watch a lot of ads or have money to spend on them.

I love this game. As you go up in levels they become harder, more challenging. Which is a good thing. But could I add one thing. As you go up into the higher levels, it becomes more expensive to play even one round. Most of the time I now have to wait 2 days before I can even play one round do to the high cost. I have spent plenty of my own money just to collect coins to play. Im not saying make the rounds free. But I am saying lower the cost per round, 25k is a little to high of a price to pay.

love that its no ads but it is definitely a pay to play game. no way to earn enough coins to keep going, esp when you start a level and have to go through half or more of your extra ones just to get a match. side games, puzzles, races etc are very hard to achieve as you only get a couple things per matching game you play. Overall not a bad game if your just trying to pass time and are not concerned about actually winning/advancing

the game and mini games in it are fun. but it is a money hole if you want to keep playing. As you go it costs more and more to play levels. When you win a level youonly get 200-500 extra per level. So in ofer to get enough for an extra round, you would have to comtinuously win like 10-15 times. Unfortunately there are not enough ways to win. You do get 1 free game every hour. that us not enough, and it's rediculous to have to log in every hour to get enough to play a 2 minute round.

Too hard. I shouldn't have to try like 10 times to get past every level. it's not like I'm not playing well, some rounds are literally unbeatable that time because no matter which dice/card thing you would have chosen you couldn't pass. Since it cost so many coins to play I'm left just sitting here. I can't even watch ads to get coins. The game has potential, but I'm only in Chapter 3 and I have been fighting tooth and nail already.

This game sucks, sorry but it does. The game won't let you win unless you keep buying credit, or wait for an hour to top up your credits. Even with using strategies, it's hard to win. I enjoyed it at the beginning but after spending over $100 I can't say it was worth it. When you do win a round you merely make over what you spend in credits. Such a shame because it was fun, now it's just frustrating 😕 😑 😫

RNG progression is not fun. If the goal is to frustrate me into spending, then I'd sooner take my money elsewhere. It's a shame, because the gameplay is fun. However, it quickly deludes into failing levels because you got unlucky. Winning doesn't even feel rewarding, because skill means nothing. Losing wouldn't be so frustrating, if it didn't cost you so many coins to continue. You only get enough coins to play a level once every hour. Fail, and you're waiting another hour to try again.

It would be more enjoyable if it were less predatory. it entices with contests that are too short-lived to be effective. The big wheel is much touted in the game, but the last several spins have yielded the worst of the available prizes. Every spin. I don't believe the odds of that happening are very good. Each game costs a few hundred coins less than you'll win, so you have to depend on the short-lived contests, purchase coins, or be very patient and very lucky, getting a good hand every play.

This game would be great if it wasn't so obviously hungry for your money. Puzzles are simple & challenges you to think strategically. It's fun until you realize there was nothing you could've done differently to win & you're forced into gold spending. Seems like they don't want you playing unless you're paying. Nothing wrong with being a business, but not offering any way to win /w more strategic moves proves what they're all about, and that's making you pay at the checkout. Best skem ever tho.

There are WAY too many pops up asking you to do in game purchases (5 or more Everytime you open the app) which can be very annoying. Also sometimes feels like the game won't allow you to progress unless you either pay or wait over a day (almost feels like they don't give you the correct pieces on purpose). Other than that the game can be fun to play

Ver annoying game. First off, it crashes frequently. Secondly, it costs too much to play a round, and the amount you get back for winning is FAR too low. In general it takes 5 or more "wins" to make up for a single loss. And you WILL lose far more often than you win! All costs increase as you progress in the game as well. In short, this game is a pure money grab!

The game is decent and fun about 40% of the time; the other is spent waiting for a patheticly small bonus when the levels cost about twice or four times as much. It's mostly luck based drawing so if you happen to make it through and need to draw three more dominoes to win, you need nearly 4-8k??? When you just made me pay nearly that or more to play the level????? The rewards and costs of items/levels are just stupidly disproportionate. Why not initiate a lives method instead of using money 🙄

I would have given it more stars but 5 days ago I made a purchase that was supposed to come with a bunch of free things. as soon as the purchase cleared the app crashed. I reloaded it, and did not receive the free bonuses. I complained multiple times and have not received a response and haven't received a response. this is the 3rd time this has happened. There are also stickers you collect in game. I had all but one, I was about to reach the last one when this happened. now it's unavailable

Highly frustrated with this game. It has all the potential to be a very fun way to pass time, but the constant hounding to buy packs (and the actual need to in order to actually advance) is overkill. It costs coins to play a level, the rewards you receive for winning a level are barely more than what you pay to play it. There are other ways to win rewards but everything circles back to needing to win levels in order to obtain those rewards too. The in-level "helps" are highly expensive coin wise

I no longer have issues with the coins provided in the game. i think it adds a layer of challenge, and as you play, there are more opportunities to gain coins. My issue now is every time I go to the game I get a pop up of "oops! Something went wrong. Please restart the game." I haven't been able to play the game lately because of this. Either I delete the game, or this gets fixed. edit: I can't get past the title screen/splash screen of the game. that is there the pop up I am getting is located

this game is fun at first, and has potential to be really fun. But you literally have to buy A LOT if you want to go far into the game. And When I say far I mean level 5 and above. Even level 5 is extremely difficult and you run out of coins so fast the only way to get more is to buy them. I have a strong feeling that if they do not change things this app will not last. It's a great idea but greedy app. Unless you are rich and have a few hundreds to drop, I wouldn't recommend this game.

The game can be fun. You win a game, but then you win maybe 500 coins more than what it cost to play. There's no incentive to keep playing. You lose way more coins than win. If you lose 3x in a row that's like 7400 coins just to win 2,800. wilds and 3 cards are expensive. I think if there was a way to have power ups or things to help it would be less frustrating. I don't know how many times I lost in a row with one domino left. A simple bomb power up to use on the last domino would be awesome.

Anyone who says they've never made a purchase even after the 5000 levels is lying to you. If you don't mind spending the money on a game, play this one. You will HAVE to spend money at some point. The levels require a LOT of coins to start and you don't get a whole lot more back than you spent and there's a TON of levels to a chapter. Run out of dominos? Pay double for 3 dominos. It's a great game other than that. You will pay for no ads - I promise you that.

Fun at first but the further you get the more it scams you! I'm above level 400, got to a level that didnt appear to be too hard but the domino's that I kept getting were not even close to what is left on the table. Had over 8 tiles in my hand with 1 tile on the table and not a single tile in my hand matched what was left. Started with over 50k, bet the min of 3,300 each game, lost it all, actually paid 1.99 for 17k more coins, lost it all in less than 20 mins. NOT AGAIN!

Not a good app. The app tries to trick your brain into thinking that the Dominoes should be pressed in a certain order to win, but no matter what order you click the domino's, the ones at the bottom that flip over dont match anything on your board forcing you to make in-app purchases or wait a whole day to get enough coins. Once you get past level 2, it's impossible to get to level 3. Each level you win, you get a star, but to need 4-5 stars per building and you need 8 buildings each level.

1st edit-the app has its own store that you have to use to make purchases at times. I purchased the 1+12 deal and didn't receive the "free" items. very irritating to buy to meet a level requirement and not get it. 2nd edit- I was finally given the items purchased, but after the promotion ended so I didn't get the coins for the promotional purchases. Will not buy again on this game.

It was fun in the beginning but now it's clear to me that this is a pay for play game. It's crazy how you complete a level and win just about the same amount of coins to play. Win one game then lose three. None of the pieces match. Then it costs a crazy amount of coins to get 3 extra pieces at a time. I made it to level 216 and I was up 90,000 points only for me to constantly use my coins to get extra pieces and now I'm down to 400 and can't play until I pay....or wait an hour...smh... I'm good!

The game starts off fun, then you have to spend coins to advance. The mini games also increase requirements and your progress slows down and it costs more to advance. I gave in and purchased a buy 1 package, get one free. I never received the items from the bonus free package. Contacted support,and I still do not have what I paid for. I received compensation ,alhough not the actual extra package. Unfortunately I,have deleted the game. Very overpriced to participate. The amounts increase too much

I really enjoyed the game at first I was getting far made purchases, was super into it. I ended up deciding i wanted to save my progress by connecting my Facebook and it was going good but after I went to sleep and woke up my account lost everything all my progress and purchases, I was back at the beginning. I have reached out multiple times through email as well as multiple times through in game chat to support. I got like 1 response and then nothing, no fixes no response. do not recommend.

Great game! I have just finished all chapters, which is about 5000 levels and have never made a purchase. Yes it takes time, over a year, but so what? I log in multiple times a day, collect my hourly amount and play a couple rounds. I just wanted to put this out there to combat the reviews that say you are forced to pay. You are not! Again, great game, love playing it and I hope you will make more chapters!
One of my favorite games!!! It's Domino's, but 90% more fun!!! Everytime I think I've just about lost I will win a "mini" game that saves me and keeps me playing!! LOVE IT!!!

The game is fun, the art style and animations are lovely, but what ultimately ruins it for me is the fact that it's so obviously rigged. If I get to my last domino, and I have plenty of dominos to try and match one of the numbers/pictures, 10 for example, and I don't get ANY of the TWO options in ALL 10 EXTRA dominos that I had in my deck, you can't tell me that's not rigged to make you lose and want to spend money in order to progress! It's infuriating! P.S. I'm NEVER spending my money here!

TBH I only played this to make a few bucks through Scrambly but it was cute & fun enough for a while. They go waaay overboard with the pop up prompts tho, I get 4-8 nearly every time I try to play the game (at least half of which are trying to get you to spend money). I don't recommend playing while half asleep you might fall for their little tricks like I did & buying stuff doesn't even help progress the game (which takes more & more "stars" the farther you go). Definitely room for improvement.

The game is very fun, but beware: If you make a single cash purchase, you will lose complete access to free ways to boost your game, like rewarded videos that are abundant up until the purchase was made. I had unlimited access to rewarded videos for over a year and the instant I made a purchase it was gone. I lost so many features just by making a $5 purchase. Paying money made the game less fun. No matter the issue, support always says "The features subject to change."

The game is interesting in itself but there is a big problem if you purchase something. There is a bug in the game and very often purchases arent recieved, you only lose the money. Even if you contact support there is no answer and they take too long to process the report, lastly when they process it they don't give you the exact things you purchased but instead send you a small compensation but less than what you paid for. All in all awful experience and lost money on nothing.

The game itself is polished and fun! But, The coin system is HORRIBLE!! After you reach a hard level you keep losing and then don't have enough coins to play and you have to wait a whole hour (and you can't stack the hourly reward so it's even worse) for a *single* try! And if you lose again? Well go for another hour or spend real money and that's an awful way to monetise a game and just make it unplayable after level 80 or so.. This can be solved easily but greed is too much! 3 STARS

Money hungry Royal Match copy cat. It starts fine. As you progress, they make the levels harder, which is great. However, they make it unwinnable sometimes so that you'll spend coins, yet with each level as the prices rise, your rewards stay the same and become sparse. The punishments are insanely harsh as well. You'll get to a point where you either buy coins (not happening) or you'll be waiting hours between levels to play. Not worth it.

Reached lv. 45. It's a fun little game, I'd say. The gameplay doesn't require much thinking, save for some strategy here and there. There's lots of little buttons in the main menu (not during the game itself) that each leads to its own pop-up for various ways of getting coins, not to mention the extra coins you get every hour on the hour, so unless you keep buying gold pieces (which get *expensive* as the game progresses), you won't run out of money anytime soon.

While the game runs smoothly and is very responsive, it is nothing more than a cash grab for the developer. Every time I open the app to play for a couple minutes I have to exit out of at least 12 different pop-ups before gameplay becomes available. The domino game can't be played strategically, and has many more additional tile sets to guarantee that you need to pay for the inevitable "continue game" at the end of your play. Don't bother unless you love being advertised to constantly.

All in all the game is fun but the more level you played the higher the entrance cost gets. I'm at 10 000 at the moment and the daily gifts are maybe 20 - 30 000. You can't play a lot and the game makes you lose a lot even with 10 cards or more left. You can't play a lot at this point which is sad. I hope at some point they change it to at least get more daily or lower the entrance cost for a game.

I agree for now. Even when they add "download and play for 31 minutes and get 20$". After.. well over an hour or more of playtime, there's no indication of the elapsed time being counted for that offer, let alone receiving the credit for it. However, yesterday, I did at least cash out 20$ worth without much hassle.

It's alright as a game but its designed so you literally CANNOT PLAY WITHOUT PAYING!!! There is ZERO opportunity to continue earning enough money to keep going. They don't offer ads, and side games require being able to play rounds of domino's which run your money out within a few hands. It's not even a skill game ...it's LUCK. You have to guess which way will end up better. Within a day or 2, you can only play about 3 rounds before you can't do anything else...except PAY.

So terrible. You WILL reach a point where you will have to use more cards or a wild card for every single round. so expect to spend nearly 10000 coins every round after about level 200, while getting less than what you spent back. The developer responds with things about "balance" and "challenge" or ways to get more coins, but it's not even about challenge. You won't get the satisfaction of doing it right. You will lose and there's absolutely no fun in the way that the game is structured.

It makes the levels significantly harder when you have more coins, or once you've made a first purchase through the app, which can be extremely frustrating when you've just won a big reward and suddenly it takes eight or ten attempts to pass a single level with extra 3 dominoes doing nothing to help you. you can get through the first 75 or so levels with the initial coins it gives you bc it makes them easy, but after that, be prepared to lose every hourly bonus it gives you within five minutes

Started off fun but once you get to the 800+ levels it's a little annoying. Sometimes it literally takes 10+ tries to beat 1 level at this point which drains your coins quick. Considering that you have to beat levels in a row to get the bonuses, it seems like an attempt to pressure you to buy more coins which when you start the app it definitely does.

This game started out great. Was easy and fun to play. I managed to get about 200k gold so was doing well. The higher the level you get to, the more gold it costs you to play a hand. Which wouldn't be a big deal, but more often than not, you don't get enough cards to get you through a hand... and soon it takes a LOT of losing before you finally win a hand. Don't get sucked in. If you want to try it out just don't give them any of your money, and delete the game when the gold is gone.

I've been playing this for a while now. the domino aspect is a lot like tripeaks solitaire which is what makes it fun. However, you have to spend tons of money to eventually never get the goal you are reaching for. I was 1 ingredient from getting the last recipe. I spent way too much money to never get the last honey (I opened like 10-15 baskets with no honey.) It seems rigged. Don't get trapped like me.

WARNING!!!! DO NOT PAY. I REALY enjoyed the ability to watch ads for extra moves. It's not like they are annoying pop-ups or banners. It was an option. They don't tell you that buying ANYTHING in the game removes the OPTION to even chose to watch an ad. That's sickeningly similar the "The first hit is free." if you know what I mean. I MEAN KING IS A GREEDY DRUG DEALER. Even deleting my data an reinstalling did not bring them back. YOU HAVE BEEN

Definitely designed to force purchases- which I guess, good for the designers. Initially the puzzles are largely possible then take a sharp turn into losing a lot of coins regardless of what you do each time. I'd rather it just had ads every level. I don't care for the deception that it has solvable puzzles when it's basically a mildly strategic slot machine.

I'm on Level 35. I'm not even being credited for Level 1. Are u serious? So, it renigs on its promise, but wants me to keep playing AND buy credits. BG music is pleasant, it's more challenging than I expected & raises the bar in measured increments w/o pressure of a timer. For those who like to challenge themselves, at their own pace. But no incentives = no play.

it's pretty fun. but you really have to spend money to progress because it costs more and more coins to play. I noticed that the reward for majestic tournament only appeared after I restarted the app. had a disappointing moment when I saw that I had won but the reward didnt reflect for quite some time at first. but it's now in so I came to change my review.

Yes, the game has no ads, is straightforward, and can be fun. But it becomes harder to play without spending money. Wilds and extra cards cost way more than the rounds. It would be better to have five lives like in other games. Will likely have to uninstall. Simply can't find enjoyment in having to quite playing without paying. Then to take all the coins to win one round makes it worse. Y'all can do better on that point. Response to developer comment: it's the coin system more than anything.

This is a fun game but I'm only leaving 1 star. I see from several other reviews I'm not alone here in not receiving purchases. My very first purchase I only received half of, it wasn't too expensive so I let it go but was still irritated. My second went through fine, so I purchased a third that I really wanted. Nothing! and part of my game advancements are missing as well. I've messaged customer service with my proof of purchase and still nothing. If I receive my items I'll leave a better star

The actual game, dominos/mahjong was enough to get me interested. Gameplay is simple and graphics are pretty good. you can really burn thru a ton of levels at the start. However, the true nature of the game becomes clear between levels 100-150. Fact is, it costs almost as much coins to play a level as you win upon completion of a level. This game is a straight up cash grab.....dont bother

I enjoy this game. However, the fact that they force you to wait after every level while they animate your earnings being added to the appropriate places made me fall behind in both the boat race and the crown collecting race. that was frustrating. Also, I made it back to first place in the crown collecting competition only to not get my prize because I was not actively in the app when the event ended. I expected it to reward me the next time I opened the app but nothing happened.

while i want to give it 5 stars this game needs some balancing out. For example the amount of coinage it takes to do some features in order to process just leaves you needing to buy more very very very quickly!! not even in monopoly go do i run out of my dice that quickly!! I have no issues buying game items but the way you run out too quickly is definitely an issue!! Rather you guys take that in consideration is on you guys but overall i do enjoy the game just as much as monopoly!!

Two rating for graphics; game is cute and fun till you lose a round because you don't have enough money. If you want to get further in the game expect to shell out some money! Even if you buy one of their "deals" it will only get you maybe five rounds because after the first two you'll use all your money to get three cards with no matches. I enjoyed playing and the game sucked me into buying "deals" but I'm done with it now.

Really fun game as long as it lets you play, after 2 days you're gonna loos all your gold. The game will become more and more difficult to win as you progress in order to make it impossible for you to keep playing unless you pay money. It showers you with reword at first to distract you from the fact that every game is high risk low reward. It is engeneered in a way that makes you thing that its a free to play game but in reality is pay to play AND pay to win with a very steep pricing point.

It's a fun game and chapters are quick to finish. However, I wish that levels didn't cost so much to do. It drains your coins really quickly and then you have to wait an hour to get more coins to play. Same with wild cards and extra cards, they shouldn't cost so much to continue. Overall, it's a fun game and easy to get into playing. My one suggestion, even though it can be annoying. is to be able to watch ads for extra coins. I rate it a solid 8/10.

😠🙈 I tried very hard to want to like this game... but it's all about the money! By the time you reach level 4 very enjoyable then you would need to buy coins to play or go every hour to collect 2200 ... then at 100,000 coins I bought it took 15 games to be at 16,000 I know how to play this game but playing is not fun getting through the game without purchasing coins ha! ha! haha! Good luck 😠

I really want to keep playing this game but I don't want to spend more money. I decided to splurge and buy a couple packages but after I did that and won several rounds the price of playing levels kept growing. Then for some reason the daily rewards have gone away so now I'm not getting any extra coins unless I wait an hour to get the bonus which is only the exact amount to play another level. Please give the daily rewards back so players can get extra coins.

I like the game, but... the rewards are too low and the cost to play a game are too high.. Can only play a round or two before you don't have enough coins to play. it cost 2000 coins to play a round, if you need to get 3 tiles it's 4000 or more and if you win the round it's just barley over 2000 coins.. so unless you spend real money in the game it's not worth it. frustrating instead of relaxing

An excellent example of vile game design The game is fun, matching tiles is simple, controls well, and looks very satisfying but the design around the game is horrid, like usual you need to pay to play levels and it gets higher as it goes. but these levels are not planned out, they're random: meaning there's no guarantee you can win a level without spending coins, and therefore money. you can get +3 random tiles for an increasing cost (not worth it) it's a vacuum, either for time or money AVOID

Fun game to play. Packs are reasonably priced, however it crashes or freezes constantly. Fortunately, games are not lost. Update: A week ago the game totally crashed and was unavailable for days. I lost money and I lost points. they did give us a meager gift, however no one answered when I was trying to figure out what happened. when the game came back up, I received no response.

Honestly, even though I like playing dominoes, this game sucks. Sometimes you'll get a reward from completing some random task, but it won't actually show up until way later. Or crazy things, like I just had 100,000 coins, I played one game without using any additional coins for anything, and when I got out of the game I had 80,000 coins. The game only cost 5,700 coins. Definitely don't spend any money in this app. It's not worth it.

I started playing this game because Free Cash said that you could get paid if pu advanced in the levels. However, once you get to chapter 2, the domino combinations get so ridiculous that you need power ups to play. The app forces you to buy the power ups to continue playing the game. This was a total waste of time, and it wasn't even that fun to play.

Cute fun game. Seems like it will take forever to advance in this game unless you are willing to spend usd. Could be a lot more fun if it weren't so obvious they want you to spend money be able to keep playing. Wait 1 or 2 hours to gain enough coins to play a round or two. Need help finishing the round? No problem just buy some coins or gold cards to finish.

It's fun in the beginning, you advance quickly, but as you advance you either have to log in hourly to gain coins or pay to keep playing. Some levels will also give you bad rolls to force you to spend coins to advance to keep playing. You also get bombarded with in game advertising to buy in game currency to help you progress. The base game is fun if it wasn't manipulated as a gamba.

I decided to play a while before I gave my honest review. The game is great at first but eventually my progress almost stopped, unless I was willing to pay money. It's suppose to be a game, and be fun right??? It's not...it's strictly a money maker for the developer. I understand money has to be made in order to maintain the game but when does it become too much? I may find another game to occupy my time instead of my wallet. Shameful!!

I enjoyed this game. But am quitting it now for the 2nd and last time. I get frustrated when I start just "breaking even" on the rounds. They cost too many coins .. I know revenue is needed to keep a game going, but come on! Pay to play is okay occasionally but I won't do it all the time. That's why you pay for an app.

The game starts off fun. But once you pass a certain level, it's just pay to play. I'm in Chapter 7 and still only getting 1 star per level. It takes 15+ stars to complete one task in the chapter. It's really ridiculous. I only downloaded the game to get money out of another app. I'm going to uninstall once the 90 days are up.

Revised review down from 5 star. I have reached Level 702 and as I climbed higher it was harder and harder for inapp purchases to process properly. After attaching receipt with required info, they always replaced with a gift from them. The last few times, it has been extremely difficult to submit messages to support. I keep getting kicked out of the app during process of attaching a receipt. after 5 times gave up. This is happening way too often especially when there is only just under 300 level

Starts pleasant enough, but very quickly turns into a pay-to-play grind where it seemingly intentionally rigs the game to prevent you from progressing. Avoid at all costs, not worth the time. I put in $30 and basically got to play the game for 1 day b4 the I moved even less than I was before due to ever-increasing prices as you go on, but stagnant rewards. The disparity between what you get for what you have to invest is abysmal. This game is malicious and predatory, and should be removed.

The game itself is very fun and entertaining. The levels also change over time and add some twists sometimes. The only drawback is that in order to play the game itself, you have to invest coins and if you win, you receive like 100 - perhaps 500 more coins (without any multiplier) back but if you lose (which happens often because the game feels like it is rigged against your favoir often) you eventually will run out of coins. Perhaps devs, you should increase the amount of coins you win.

I really loved this game, it was my way to "relax". But 3 weeks ago, my game broke. I can't play because I don't get the 1-hour bonus. For example, if It's 6 pm for me, it tells me to wait until 01:30 am to get the bonus. I wait but then the counter restarts again, 24 hours. I tried contacting the game bug team, but I didn't get an answer. Overall, I really really loved this game and I would normally give it 5 stars but because of this bug, I just can't.

Update to original review... I would change my 1 star rating to a zero star review, if I could. I decided to download the app again, noting the developer comments. Nothing has changed with the exception of more "purchase" pop up ads. The game is beyond frustrating once you reach a certain level. No way to beat levels, unless you spend actual money. You will lose coins quickly or spend half your bank just to do so. Permanently deleting this app. Pay for play complete sham.

I'm still disappointed.. It doesn't get better later on but worse (level 300<). The only thing that's good about the game is the design. The levels cost to play, the rng of the dominos is absolutely abysmal and always against me, and in every level I need to pay for a booster because there's always exactly one domino left. Either lower the prices or make the wins more bountiful. Feels unplayable. I wouldn't buy in game coins with real money if they disappear so fast.

i did give it 5 stars and it is addicting, but it is becoming boring. when you play every day, put so much money into the game and find it's not worth it, it's disappointing. when you play the highest level and everything is x8 but the hammers for the temple is only x4, that is stupid! when you play the highest level, but in order to continue playing you have to pay so many coins, to keep playing you never wind up benefiting and winning more coins to break even, it doesn't seem worth it anymore.

I love the game! However, couldn't you make it beneficial for players who get up into your higher levels to get more coins? If you want to play the game with either the 2x's to the 8x's the amount of wins, you don't make any of your coins back! That is a complete downfall for any player that wants to keep going! The coin reward is not beneficial for the win! You need to make it to where you can make your coins back for continuing to play the game! And when will new chapters become available?

0/10 - Stay Away! Game is HIGHLY fixed/manipulated. Game seemingly knows when I'm about to run out of tokens, which makes the chances/odds go 100% against me, EVERYTIME! AVOID GAME!!!!!!!! All they want is your money. I've made some purchases, some of which never even landed in my account. Getting in touch with agents to resolve issues is next to impossible. ALL around, the game is horrible. Other "Pay to Play" games at least give you some REAL chances to play, without dropping a dollar.

was fun at first but you will never get anywhere in this game with as many coins as it takes just to play one level and if you don't beat that level then it takes 2,100 coins to do again, and thats all you get for beating a level. way to much for fun. they really try to get you to spend money after getting to a certain level so sad. I don't recommend if playing for free and fun

I deleted the game. Way too many ads! I got tired of getting down to the very last Domino and being just short of the amount of coins needed to get more tiles. over and over again I'd get down to one tile and oops not enough coins. I got sick of it and deleted the game. if you log in every hour you can get coins. I'm just not going to be that devoted to a game. It was frustrating. I'll just play a different game.

Agree with all other reviews. Really enjoyed this game at first but then got increasingly frustrated by the obvious "cheating" of the game. I understand it wants me to buy coins but it could be a little less pushy about it. Everytime I enter the app I'm swarmed by 5 popups for offers I have to close. Every game costs money to even play so you better have coins to even play. And then when you do you can buy extra dominos to complete levels and then those won't match at all! Total scam.

Yet another one of those games that pulls you in by making it fun and interesting and making it possible to win without spending money at first. As you progress higher though, you'll notice every single day you can win once or twice, then you pull all the wrong cards again and again until the only way to keep playing is by waiting some hours and saving up, or spending money. Not a good game once you really start to sink your teeth into it and enjoy it.

It's a fun game and I like the cute little characters. But, you don't get much playtime unless you're willing to fork over some money. Even then, you STILL don't get much playtime. It's unfortunate because I'll inevitably forget this game exists at some point because I'll get used to not being able to play at all. Increase the rewards after winning a level or maybe make it easier to obtain rewards from the side games?

push to watch ad and it takes me to a purchase. I enjoy this game, but sometimes when I push the button to watch an ad for rewards, it takes me to a purchase screen instead. it has happened 4 times today. it got to be prevalent enough that I was able to take video of it happening. this experience is very uncool. and I have also contacted customer support in-game

You can't really get much game play in because it costs coins to play each level, they hardly ever give you the right tiles, all in an effort to get you to spend money. This game literally isn't addictive, or attention grabbing enough to pay the money they expect you to pay to play. It's just annoying they try forcing you. My bf downloaded this game on my phone literally because u only get 20 min of game play before you're forced to pay, I would for sure delete this game.

I loved this game but the ads for it on other games is really annoying cuz the add takes me to the Domino's game when I haven't requested it, the add is way too long and you have to exit 3 times before you get out of the ad , that's not right, fix it!! I can't seem to get the game to stay loaded, I don't know if it's my phone or your game. I now cannot load the game it keeps shutting down, this game sucks!!!!!

If you love pop ups (8-10) every time you open your app this is the game for you. When it gives you 15 minutes of free tickets/ free starts you might get 3 games in if you're lucky because you have to close pop ups before you can play. Spent alot of money buying coins to be able to finish the album and never got the last for cards needed it just kept giving me the same cards. Lost interest and have since moved on to other games. Hope you have better luck than I did.

i have spent about 15 bucks and am on level 162. the game essentially forces you to spend more coins. you will not get far without spending money. keep that in mind. you will almost always have one domino left and need to spend more coins than you will ever get from winning. it sucks cause it's actually a fun game but get so obviously screwed over constantly makes me not want to play. Just beware if you are playing this to make money, you will end up spending more than you will make.

Was pretty good, not astonishing. However, I noticed it quickly became P2W. You suddenly stop getting dominos that are anywhere close to what you need, and you run out of the gold that you have earned. You can't restart levels without gold, you can't get extra tiles without gold... Basically, you have to pay to play this trashcan of a game.

This game is actually fun AT FIRST, but you learn this very important rule: After the first chapter, the game changes drastically. Any coins that you have, no matter whether they're earned or purchased in-app, are taken from you because the game starts doing things like dealing out 10 dice in a row without a match for then on the board, and, when the supply of dice runs out, you have to buy more with your coins or lose progress that you've made. It's not fun to be taken advantage of

Blatant money grab. They try to hook you in with a series of easy levels then bam, almost every round you need to buy extra dominoes or a wildcard and you're immediately out of coins unless you spend cash. Many other games out there with the exact same concept that aren't nearly as impossible to beat and advance. Fortunately I only wasted $1.99 and now this game will get deleted. Don't waste your time, you'll only end up frustrated & stuck like many other players out there.

There's a core of an okay game here that's weighed down by desperately trying to get you to pay them. Opening ads require you to click past them 8-10 times (sometimes the same one shows up again after you already dismissed it!) All of them trying to get you to pay money for events, then the coin cost to reward ratio is horrible so its easy to play one game, lose, then have to wait an hour for more coins.

Very cute animation, easy 2 learn & has a nice pace which allows a fairly good amount of gameplay w/o requiring u 2 spend any $$. Style is very similar to Bingo Blitz so I wouldn't be surprised if its made by the same developer. So if u like that game, then surely u'll like this!Possibly more since there r certain frustrations I have where Im sure Im not alone. Mostly where timing/select glitches r concerned. Just cheap ways u feel robbed that wouldnt be an issue while playing this

I LOVE Dice Dreams. But this game isn't as well put together. You only receive 1 star for completing a level. You need stars to complete the tasks for the chapters. I am almost to level 200, but stuck in the 6th chapter. You have to pay with your coins to try each level. Even if you use the multiplier, you only get one star. It's definitely not as used friendly as Dice Dreams 😒

I enjoy the game but there are wayyy too many popups. It takes forever to be able to play because EVERY TIME I open the app it forces me to cycle through EVERY promotion and event. like guys. I get it. I saw it the first time. I can navigate to it myself. add a little arrow or notificatiom dot and let me click on it myself instead of shoving everything in my face every time. Let me play the game instead of forcing the offers and events onto my screen and blocking me from interacting until closed

This game might be fun if you really like dominoes, and are willing and able to spend a bunch of money. Due to RNG you *will* get to the point where you cannot afford to play another level, and you will not be very far when this happens. Just not feasibly a free2play game. Just logging in to get hourly coins you have between 4-10 pop-ups to close with advertisements for packages or related events (more $$ to spend). I'd much rather watch an ad video after each game than this frustrating model.

I have been enjoying this game, however, it is starting to get almost impossible to complete. The rewards are well and it allows you to continue playing more. But it is getting way too ridiculous at the amount of coins that need to be used just to get past a level. Then you can only collect enough every hour that allows you one entry. Since you are not guaranteed the outcome, you have to make sure that you have almost triple the amount to get through. This is my reason for 3 stars.

Nice game - immediately addicted. Graphics & gameplay good. No ads but pop-ups wanting you to buy coins, which you have to if you want to play for any length of time. If you don't pass a level & you don't have coins, you either have to pay or wait an hour to play again. The cost of the level far outweighs what you win, & the in game powerups cost more coins than a game. I purchased a package and never got the rewards. Cust care sent a few puzzle pieces which doesn't fix it. Won't buy any more.

I would give it 5 stars as I enjoy the game play a lot. however the last 3 days the game keeps crashing whenever I try playing it. There are lots of "events" that happen. So you get like 7 pop-ups at the start of the game. Its possible the game keeps trying to load one and crashes instead. But I've reached out to support twice and nothing has been resolved and nobody has gotten back to me. So 1 star for not being able to play the game and not getting any customer support.

Don't play unless you plan on spending money. After the initial day or 2 of playing the game becomes almost unplayable, you have to wait an hour to retry a level. if you had the ability to watch ads instead of a paywall, the game would probably be much better. Edit: much worse than when I first wrote review. I have no way of knowing for sure, but it seems like the game gets even harder after you spend money.

Got to play this game through a reward offer; Fun at first, but as you continue on, the pay-to-play aspect gets in your face harder and harder. It gets more difficult to even play more than 5 minutes in the later stages without paying for the virtual currency. + the fact that everything is likely to be scripted and not based on change/randomness, makes me more likely to uninstall it.

I am so confused.. not only is the game way too expensive to play, but I purchased 2 different packages that come with "cookies" to feed my "pet" in the game.. only to find out that there is a limit on how many "cookies" you can have at a time. BOTH packages came with more cookies than you're allowed to have. not both together, BOTH EACH. that's literally false advertisement and selling under false pretenses. AND I'm no further in the game than I was, because it wasn't enough to get me anywhere

Domino Dream is a fun, colorful game that starts off feeling relaxing and rewarding. The visuals are appealing, the gameplay is simple to understand, and completing levels gives a nice sense of progress. At first, it feels like a great way to unwind and enjoy a casual puzzle experience. However, as you advance, the game becomes increasingly frustrating due to its heavy reliance on coins. Each new game cost coin and losses quickly drain your balance. fun challenge but need coins to continue on

One of the most blatant "we don't want you to win without spending money" I've ever seen. after level 65 maybe, maybe before maybe after, you will end up spending must of your coins just to try and finish a level. They make it literally impossible to complete a level without spending your coins on their "safety" functions, and let me tell you, just cause you spent your coins on one, doesn't mean you won't have to buy it 3 more times, that same round. disgusting.

the game itself isnt too bad, but beware of the in app purchases especially when using play points. support takes more than a day and a half to get back (I still havent heard even a "we will look into it," from support), and there are limited ways to get refunds. honestly kind of annoying because I wasted some extra play points I had on an in game purchase and now have no access to my purchase, no reply from game support, and no way to get the points I wasted back.

Crashes Constantly!!! I spent a bunch of money recently and now I can't even play a single level! It makes me scroll through all the ads and then when I'm FINALLY done pressing the X to pass them it crashes. The developers should refund my money because I can't use the coins and items! It was crashing every couple levels before and it gets extremely annoying to have to load every single ad over and over! Please fix these things! I have loved playing this game and would keep playing if fixed!

The game is fun to play however I hate that every time I open the app there are 10 things I have to X out of just to start playing. It makes it hard to play whenever I may have a few free minutes. I'm also glad there aren't ads to watch, however it might be nice to have the option to watch one to get more coins so I can keep playing. I'm not one to shell out alot of money for a game but I don't mind watching an ad for rewards if I choice to.

while I love the game, I feel like the game doesn't want us to play it. I counted- a whole dozen pop ups every single time you open the game and try to start playing. each taking several seconds to load whatever little animation there is before you can exit it. then another dozen pop ups after you finally play a round. if you want to play a a quick round during break or something, good luck. I wish you'd just have the little icons with dots pop up like everything else... it's really enough to -2

Honestly, it's a great game. Visually appealing, fun gameplay, and it's addictively satisfying. The problem is, after about 200 levels or so, it basically becomes pay to win. I understand they're trying to make money, but the game is pretty much rigged for you to lose, and that forces you to buy from the market. They don't even really try to hide it either. I have no issues with tossing the devs a few dollars because I enjoy the game, but it shouldn't be mandatory. For that, I give it 3 stars.

please fix! I enjoy the game when I can play. sometimes it takes several attempts just to get the game to load. then once the game loads, there's anywhere from 3-9 different things that pop up to clear.sometimes it crashes after that, sometimes not.it also happens right after I win a level or when I start to play level. I have checked for updates & there's no current updates. this is very frustrating! please fix it

There are no power ups. There's no explanation as to what your little character guy is doing or why. The graphics are good and the gameplay is decent but the lack of power ups or boosts and the constant pop ups of things that technically part of the game are really annoying (like limited time events). It's so bad the thing is basically not playable. They should spend more time making the actual domino game play better instead of doing all the side quest junk

Fun game but too many annoying pop ups to buy power ups especially when you first load the game you have 5 to 9 pop ups, That's a little excessive. Had to uninstall. Ruined the fun and was beginning to frustrate me. At least give a pay option to remove the annoying pop ups. 1 year later the annoying pop ups are even worse. at times have to X out of power up advertisements up to 12 times before you can play. at least give an option to remove that or pay a fee to remove them so frustating.

I enjoy the game but the cost of coins goes up way to fast to play each level, levels are not about strategy more luck and there is no way to continue one without costing coins which are hard to gain to start with. I really enjoy the game but I do believe I will delete sooner then later as it is just geared to push you into purchasing things then actual progression in the game.

This game was great in the beginning. But, the more levels you pass, the more coins you have to use to start the next level. They really enable you to make in-app purchases because you barely win enough gold to make it to the next level. They constantly show tutorials for everything no matter what level you're at. I didn't have issues when making in-app purchases before, but just recently I tried making one and I didn't even get it. I contacted support and they never got back to me.

Not a game that's designed for the user. Simple to play, but the rewards earnt compared to the cost of each level is a diminishing return. By level 70 expect to have used a bulk of your coins if not all of them. This is a game that squeezes you into spending money to play. Find something else that is a little more focused on your entertainment than this one.

levels become impossible to pass without forking out cash, there used to be an option to watch ads to keep playing. that option is gone now. A positive, no forced ads...no ads at all right now. update: levels are still impossible to pass without paying, still no ads forced or optional to progress without paying. I play once a day, usually try to pass the same level once each day. will uninstall shortly

If I could upload attachments I would show how their "support" is very unsupportive! I have paid multiple in-app purchases and have not received the full purchase. I have also gotten so far on challenges that I stop receiving the items to get any further in the challenge! Do not spend a ton of money like I did! They will block you from advancing then require a bunch of ridiculous stuff to correct their mess up OR just not respond to your support request!
