This is such a frustrating game and not worth your time. It's very luck dependant and you only receive enough money to play 1 short game every hour. If you don't win, you have to wait an hour to play again. And then you'll lose again without being able to do anything about it. All the timed events only last 24ish hours, so if you can't play due to lack of money, you can't progress. The actual domino game is fun, but if you can't play, what's the point?

If you're playing for money, they make it virtually impossible to win. The beginning was fine. I can't even complete a chapter with the purchases I make. This app is not like the arcade. Why should anyone make a $2+purchase just to clear a chapter if that? If you run out of dominos they require a 6,000 + coin reduction to continue.

Initially it was fun, but as I got just past checkpoint 8, It really was nearly impossible to finish any game. The algorithm is definitely rigged. So you're maybe making $50 in coin per game if you win that session and that's not including having to spend $4,000 for the golden dice to help you get out of the run out dominoes or having to pay $3,500 coin for an extra three Domino's that don't even help you. Uninstalling. GREEDY!!

the game would be fun if it actually worked! EVERY time I get a big prize the game glitches and doesn't give me my prize. I contacted support and heard nothing and sometimes when I'm playing my dominos don't turn over and I have no colors to match. if the game didn't glitch so much it would be great but I'm ready to uninstall it due to all the errors

game is nice but unlike other games you get daily reward coins to play. after its used up its only possible to get coins to play once per hour. so even after returning to the game after 5 6 hours you just get enough coins to play once. really annoying if you cant pass a level. in order to play more you can only buy stuff in the app. i would like to play a bit more but its only possible to play when i get the daily reward. not worth to download if you want to play alot without spending money.

Game is fun to play when you can actually play it. They make it very difficult to play without actually spending money. Plus you guys need to stop with all the pop-up side games. Editing to change rating The amount of pop-ups when I open the app are crazy. There are anywhere from 7 to 10 each time The win to loosing ratio is like 3/10. They don't make this a skill based game that's fun to play. Just as you get your currency built up, they make it impossible to win any level unless you burn through your currency every stage. or like having 20 dominoes to spare and never finding a match on a single one. so lame, don't download unless you're just looking to kill time, developers did a terrible job making this a fun game.

I'm only playing this for Fetch points. It could be a fun game but around chapter 4, it very obviously becomes geared toward trying to force you to buy any and every type of in-game currency. Even the pet treats (If you don't feed the little blob enough, the game threatens to take it away). Also, the pop-ups! It takes 40 seconds to start the game up because of all the redundant messages being shoved in your face every time. This is not a game worth playing outside of Fetch. Blatant money grab.

I'm beyond done w/this greedy game. I'm so fed up with clicking out of the hundreds of forced pop ups. Just got a 10 minute free round ticket and I was only able to use it for maybe 2.5 min b/c of the damn popups! I don't care about seeing key accumulation in the Dream Pass. I don't care about seeing the stupid petal thing fly. Should be able to look at them when I feel like it. Your stupid ads make me certain that I'll never purchase anything. Uninstalling

I uninstalled today after maybe a week and a half? The actual gameplay is decent enough, not super challenging but fun enough, but all the mechanics surrounding it are insufferable. Open the app and sit through a dozen mtx pop ups. Finish a level and you have to watch half a dozen unskippable animations (really annoying with buff timers and race mechanics). Lose a level and you don't earn the currency to keep playing. Finally, you can't finish any events without completing an mtx. Hard pass.

This game is definitely fun but feels rigged at times. The amount of coins needed to play each level is high. The winnings are usually low and we have to play multiple times to win each level. Sometimes losing with only 1 domino left. The events are good but most of the time impossible to win anything. Overall, the game is good but the fun element tends to be gone with these issues. Please rectify these issues.

The game itself is alright and fun. what annoys me is that many of the levels are designed to make you lose, some are downright impossible to win unless you spend more coins than what you earn, which prompts you to want to spend $ on it in order to keep playing. it's fine wanting people to spend money but outright rigging games for loss is messed up.

I like the game far more than I anticipated I would. However there is NO part of this game you do not pay for. The coin price you pay to just play a board is ridiculously high to begin with. Add having to PAY for extra dominos you flip just to be able to finish the game & you cannot progress through this game quicklyor hit time-sensitive deadlines unless you also make continued in app purchases. This is why I gave a 4 ⭐ rating & why I believe this game has no longevity. What A shame!

It's one of those games where you will inevitably HAVE to spend money to keep playing unless you want to wait many hours for the freebie currency to regenerate. I'm only playing this game because a cash advance app requires it to get points to get a cash advance. After that, I will be deleting this and never looking back. It's a game of pure chance where it's set up to extract money out of you like 99% of the games out there these days.

Update: This charming little game is dominos mahjong style. And best of all -- no annoying ads! just a fun game. I've tested and reviewed quite a lot of games on this platform, and I've been bombarded with ads in some games to the point of quitting in frustration. This game runs smooth doesn't heat up my phone either. Just be careful or you'll run out of coins (in game currency) real quick. 😉 Original review: So far it's fun.

Unplayable without paying money It would be fun if it didn't cost so much to play each level. And winning a level barely covers the cost of playing it. So you can't really earn money. Then you lose too many times and you literally can't play the game. I did buy a coin pack and it did not unlock the free items (as it was supposed to) and the events come and go so fast you can't complete them.

Its horrible. I enjoyed the domino games, but after the first area, the stars drastically increase. You can collect 2,000 coins every so often, but that only covers ONE GAME. Unless you spend money. And the events are barely there, outrageous to win ANYTHING, and take so long to do. Not to mention even winning just one game takes 2 to 3 tries unless you pay double in coins because none of your dominos match. AND EVERYTIME YOU OPEN IT IT HAS ITS ADDS FOR BUYING MORE COINS. JUST. LET. ME. PLAY.

If you like gambling, download away. As a puzzle game fan, I hate it. The randomization of tiles leads to a luck rather than skill based game, feeding back into microtransactions. It does not feel rewarding to complete a level if there is no skill or critical thought involved. Multiple times I have started a level with the first tile being impossible to play. I find little payoff or enjoyment and wish the developers put more effort into legitimate challenge rather than impossible chance.
